title: Real Estate ISA / Appointment Setter — CINC Leads (Remote, EST Hours)
description:
Ottawa Property Shop · Realty Inc. Brokerage Full-Time (40 hrs/week) · Monday–Friday, EST hours Pay: $5–$8 USD/hour (based on experience) + $100 bonus per closed deal (Estimated base: ~$800–$1,280 USD/month at 40 hrs/week, plus bonuses)



We're not looking for someone to "just make calls." We're looking for someone who wins.



About the Team



I'm Rony Rizk — one of Ottawa's top-performing REALTORS®, with 113 five-star Google reviews and a growing team at Ottawa Property Shop, Realty Inc. Brokerage.



We generate a consistent, high-volume flow of real buyer and seller leads through CINC — one of the most powerful real estate lead platforms in North America. The leads are real. The volume is consistent. What we need is the right person to convert them.



This is a full-time, long-term role for someone who treats appointment setting as a craft — and wants to be rewarded for results.



The Role



Engage. Qualify. Nurture. Book. You'll be the first voice our leads hear after they come in — your job is to separate motivated buyers and sellers from browsers, and turn real opportunities into booked appointments.



Call and follow up with buyer and seller leads daily through CINC CRM

Build rapport fast — uncover motivation, timeline, and goals in the first 2 minutes

Qualify relentlessly — know who deserves your time and who doesn't

Book consultations directly onto the agent's calendar

Keep CRM notes sharp — accurate and organized after every call

Send strategic follow-up texts and
s to keep leads warm between calls

Hit daily and weekly KPIs consistently, not occasionally

What Success Looks Like

Outbound dials per day: 120–180

Lead response time: under 5 minutes

Appointments booked: consistent, week over week

CRM accuracy: 100% — every call logged



Please note: All calls are recorded and reviewed. Leads may only be marked lost/dead in CRM after a real, logged conversation or a documented, reasonable number of attempted contacts — not on assumption or lack of effort. Dispositioning leads as dead without a genuine attempt to reach and engage them is grounds for immediate termination.



Trial Period



The first 7 working days are a mutual trial. During this window:



Your first 10–15 calls are reviewed together before you work leads unsupervised

We're listening for real energy and engagement on the call, not just call volume

Either side can end the arrangement with no hard feelings if it's not the right fit — better to know in week one than month two



Who You Are



Fluent in English — clear, confident, professional on every call

A natural rapport-builder who asks the right questions and actually listens

Comfortable with objections — you don't freeze when someone says "I'm just browsing"

Self-disciplined — you perform with or without someone watching

Coachable — you take feedback and apply it immediately

CRM-savvy — experience with CINC, Follow Up Boss, or similar is a strong plus

Set up to work professionally — reliable internet, quiet workspace, backup power/internet if possible

Available Monday–Friday during EST hours



Why People Stay on This Team

Competitive base pay + $100 for every closed deal you booked — your hustle pays off directly

Full scripts, training, and systems support from day one

Clear growth path: ISA → Senior ISA → Team Lead → Leadership roles

Stable, full-time role with a team that's actively growing

Your results are seen and rewarded — not buried in a team quota



Payment: [Wise, or PayPal, and pay schedule — bi-weekly]. 



How to Apply



Include the following in your application:



A brief intro about your calling and appointment-setting experience

Any experience with real estate, CRMs, or lead follow-up

A short voice sample OR a written role-play as the ISA making a first call to a new lead

Your availability and desired hourly rate



Important: To show us you pay attention to detail, begin your application with the words: "Booked & Ready." Applications without this phrase will not be reviewed.



Final step before hire: Shortlisted candidates will do a live phone screening call with us — not just a submitted recording. We're listening for real, sustained energy on an unscripted call, since that's the single biggest predictor of success in this role.



If you're ambitious, dependable, and ready to build something long-term with a serious real estate team — we'd love to hear from you. Apply now.

title: AI Creative Strategist / Creative Operator
description:
ENGLISH MASTERY REQUIRED



Compensation: $3,000 USD/month + Performance Bonus



About the Role:



We're looking for a highly capable AI Creative Strategist / Creative Operator.



This is a hands-on creative role. We're not looking for someone who simply comes up with ideas and hands them off. We want someone who can take a script, concept, or offer and turn it into highly engaging content from start to finish.



You'll use your own creative skill set, AI tools, content sourcing, and a dedicated video editor to produce high-performing advertising content.



You'll work across:



Affiliate Marketing: Auto insurance, debt relief, home services, and other consumer offers.

Ecommerce: Paid and organic content for our Canadian digital health brand.



Our production workflow is already built in Trello. Your job is to step into that system and own the creative execution.



What You'll Do



You'll receive a script, concept, or creative request and determine how to turn it into something people actually want to watch.



You'll be responsible for:



Turning scripts into engaging short-form video concepts

Generating AI video, images, avatars, voices, animations, and other assets

Sourcing B-roll and additional creative assets

Developing visual hooks, pattern interrupts, and engaging openings

Working directly with your assigned video editor

Directing pacing, captions, transitions, sound design, and overall execution

Reviewing drafts and providing clear revision instructions

Taking creative from request → production → revisions → completion

Researching competitors, viral content, ads, and emerging creative formats

Constantly testing new AI tools and creative workflows



You don't need to personally edit every video, but you should be capable of building the creative direction and assets needed to make it great.



What We're Looking For



The ideal person sits somewhere between a Creative Strategist, AI Creator, and Content Producer.



You should:



Have a strong understanding of short-form video and social media

Understand hooks, pacing, retention, and what makes people stop scrolling

Be highly comfortable with AI image and video tools

Be able to take a written script and visualize how it should come to life

Understand direct-response advertising

Have strong creative instincts

Be resourceful and able to figure things out independently

Learn new AI tools and workflows quickly

Communicate effectively with video editors

Move quickly and manage multiple projects at once

Take ownership of getting creative across the finish line



Most importantly, you need to be someone who actually likes making things.



We're interested in people who actively experiment with tools for AI video, image generation, avatars, voice generation, lip syncing, animation, image-to-video, and AI-assisted editing.



AI creative is moving incredibly quickly. We want someone who stays on top of what's possible and is constantly looking for new ways to create better content.



What Success Looks Like



- You'll help us produce a consistent pipeline of highly engaging creative across multiple offers.

- Over time, you'll use performance data to understand what's working, iterate on winning concepts, and help us build a larger creative operation around you.



Initially, you'll be paired with a dedicated video editor. We expect to add copywriters, additional editors, and other creative resources as the operation grows.



How to Apply



Send us:



A short introduction.

Examples of video content you've created.

Examples of AI-generated content you've created.

The AI tools you currently use.

Any experience with paid social, direct-response, affiliate marketing, or ecommerce.



We're much more interested in what you can make than where you've worked.

title: Customer Support Specialist — European Fashion E-Commerce (Shopify) | Long-Term, Full Support Ownership
description:
CUSTOMER SUPPORT SPECIALIST — EUROPEAN FASHION E-COMMERCE (SHOPIFY) | LONG-TERM, FULL SUPPORT OWNERSHIP:



JOB TYPE: Part-time, but 6–7 days per week (see "How the schedule works" below)

SALARY: $4.5 USD/hour + performance bonus

HOURS: Roughly 2–4 hours per day, 6–7 days a week, inside a fixed daily window that overlaps

with UK business hours (GMT/BST)



ABOUT US:

We run a small portfolio of women's fashion e-commerce brands selling into the United

Kingdom. Everything runs on Shopify with a dropshipping supply chain, which means fast

shipping questions, order changes, sizing questions, returns and the occasional angry

customer.



HOW THE SCHEDULE WORKS -- READ THIS CAREFULLY:

This is the part most applicants get wrong, so I want to be completely honest about it up front.



Customers write to us every day, including weekends. That means I need someone who checks

and clears the inbox 6 to 7 days a week, inside an agreed daily window. It is not a

Monday-to-Friday job.



The number of hours per day varies. Some days the queue is cleared in 90 minutes. Other days

we launch a campaign, a store scales, or a shipment is delayed and it's a full workday. There

will also be quiet periods where a store is paused and there is genuinely little to do.



That's why the salary is a fixed monthly amount, not an hourly rate. You get paid the same

in a quiet week as in a busy week, and in exchange I get your reliable daily availability. Hubstaff

is used for visibility into how the work is going, not to shave hours off your pay.



What I need from you: consistency. Every day, in your window, tickets are handled. Even if it's

Sunday, even if it's slow, even if it's busy.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

-Handle all incoming customer tickets in Help Scout 
 + contact form), for multiple

stores

-Work with AI-generated draft replies: review them, correct them, make them sound

human, and send. You are the quality control, not a copy-paste machine

-Write in natural British English. Our customers are UK shoppers and the replies go out

under our brand name. When we open a new European market, you handle those

replies with DeepL and check that the tone still fits the brand

-Look up and edit orders in Shopify Admin: tracking, address changes, cancellations,

refunds, replacements

-Chase tracking issues and coordinate with suppliers when a parcel is stuck or lost

-Keep response times low and stay inside our refund/replacement policy without needing

approval for every ticket

-Flag recurring problems (bad product, wrong sizing chart, unclear delivery time) instead

of just answering the same ticket 40 times



HARD REQUIREMENTS -- PLEASE DONT APPLY IF YOU MISS ONE OF THESE:

-Proven experience in fashion dropshipping specifically. Not general BPO, not call

centre, not SaaS support. You have supported a fashion store with 5–20 day delivery

times and you know what those tickets look like

-Shopify Admin — you can find an order, edit it, issue a partial refund and read a

fulfilment status without a tutorial

-Hubstaff — we track hours with Hubstaff (screenshots + activity). You need to be

comfortable with that

-ChatGPT or Claude — you use AI daily in your work and you know when the output is

wrong

-DeepL or a comparable translation tool, used in a real support workflow

-Fluent written and spoken English. Written English needs to be near-native: your

replies go straight to European customers under our brand name

-Reliable internet, own computer, and the ability to work independently in a small team



NICE TO HAVE:

-Familiarity with the UK market: Royal Mail / Evri / Yodel tracking, UK returns

expectations, British spelling and tone

-Experience with Help Scout, Gorgias, Zendesk or Freshdesk

-Experience with chargebacks/disputes in Shopify Payments

Your own trackers, macro libraries or SOPs that you built yourself



WHAT YOU GET:

-$4.5 USD/hour to start, reviewed after 60 days based on measurable results (response

time, CSAT, refund rate)

-Performance bonus on top of the base rate

-A long-term position. We are looking for someone to stay for years, not for one season.

-As the brands grow, this role grows: more responsibility, more stores, more pay

Direct communication with the owner. No layers, no politics



THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF:

-You need a manager to tell you what to do every day

-You disappear for two days when something goes wrong

-You send AI output without reading it

-You are applying to 40 jobs today and this is number 23

-You cannot or will not work weekends, or you already have another client in the same

daily window



HOW TO APPLY:

Applications that skip a step will be deleted without reply. This is intentional, I'd rather have 5

serious applications than 50 copy-paste ones.



1. Start your application with the word VELVET as the first word of your message.



2. List the fashion dropshipping stores you have supported. For each one: store name or URL,

the market they sold to, your role, and how long you were there.



3. Give me your numbers: how many tickets per day you handled, your average first response

time, and your CSAT if you tracked it. If you don't know your numbers, say so honestly instead

of inventing them.



4. Answer this real scenario in max 120 words, exactly as you would send it to the customer:

A customer ordered a dress 19 days ago. Tracking shows "delivered" 3 days ago,

but she says she never received it. She has already sent 2 angry
s today and

is threatening a chargeback and a public review. Our policy allows a replacement or

a refund, but only after we have checked with the carrier, which takes up to 72

hours. Write the
 you would send her.

Write this answer yourself. I use AI every day and I can tell. I'm not testing your prompting, I'm

testing your judgement and your English.



5. Record a 60-second voice message or Loom introducing yourself and telling me why

fashion support suits you. This is only to hear your spoken English; it does not need to be

polished.



6. Tell me exactly which daily time window you can commit to (in Philippine time), whether

weekends are a problem for you, what other clients or jobs you currently have and at what

hours, your monthly rate expectation, and the date you can start.



7. Ask me at least one real question about the role or the business.

I read every complete application personally and reply to everyone who follows all 7 steps.

Shortlisted candidates get a paid trial task before we agree on anything long-term.

title: Social Media Researcher
description:
We're hiring an Instagram Researcher to work and learn directly with the founders of MakeFans. This is a long-term, part-time role with a clear path to grow. If you're driven, consistent, and take ownership of results, read on.



The Role



Every Instagram assistant starts as a Researcher and grows into a Marketer. You'll begin by learning what makes content win, and as your judgment and consistency prove out, you'll grow into running Instagram accounts end-to-end. title: Automations & Tech Specialist (GoHighLevel + n8n) — Remote, Full-Time
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We're an AI-first education company, and we're hiring a second Automations & Tech Specialist because our build demand has outgrown one person. Every funnel, automation, and workflow that powers our company has to work perfectly, especially when 20,000+ people are in a live masterclass or 3,000+ students onboard at once.



This is a hands-on building role. You'll own funnel builds, automations, and workflow updates across marketing and operations. You're comfortable with AI tools (we use Claude every day), you think in logic flows, and you take pride in having zero broken automations.



If you're a builder who loves GoHighLevel and n8n and wants to grow, keep reading.



ABOUT THE COMPANY



The Uncommon Business is one of the world's fastest-growing AI-first education companies. We teach business leaders to build intelligent systems, not just prompt tools. We don't do busywork, legacy thinking, or 80-hour work weeks. We build systems where AI handles the repeatable work and humans do the irreplaceable work. We're profitable and run on EOS. You'll be promoted based on impact and ownership, not how long you've been here. High performers thrive here. Passengers don't last.



WHAT YOU'LL DO (YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES)



GoHighLevel Build Ownership: Build, optimize, and maintain automations, funnels, forms, pipelines, and membership portals inside GoHighLevel for marketing and student delivery. You're comfortable in GHL custom code, and you can take Claude-generated HTML and turn it into a live, tested page without hand-holding.

Automation in n8n and GoHighLevel: Build and monitor the automations connecting our tools (GHL, Slack, Notion, Baserow, Thinkific, Supabase, and ManyChat) with zero broken workflows. New builds go into n8n, where you build in error-handling and self-healing. You also keep our legacy Zapier automations running while we migrate them to n8n.

Marketing Funnel Delivery: Own the funnel and automation builds behind launches and campaigns. Move fast without dropping quality so Marketing and Operations don't bottleneck on one builder.

First-Line Support and Monitoring: Be the first responder when something breaks. Diagnose tag errors, workflow gaps, and integration failures within 24 hours, and own the access and build requests coming through the intake queue. Then automate the recurring problems away with error-handlers and batched alert digests.

Documentation and Clean Handoffs: Document what you build with process maps and Loom walkthroughs so anyone can maintain it. Your handoffs never come back with questions.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR (REQUIREMENTS)



You have built production automations in GoHighLevel AND n8n or Zapier that handle hundreds of users and hold up under heavy traffic, with real error handling, not just simple workflows.

You have n8n experience and want to grow it, and you're comfortable in GHL custom code enough to take a block of Claude-generated HTML and ship it live.

You are AI-first and use Claude (or similar) daily to build faster, troubleshoot smarter, and document better, and you know when to double-check by hand.

You think in process maps and can turn a messy workflow into a clean diagram with decision trees and system links that anyone can follow.

You are detail-obsessed and stay calm under pressure. When 3,000 students are onboarding and something breaks, you investigate, fix, and communicate without panicking.

You can work USA CST business hours (9am – 5pm CST) and have a reliable computer and internet connection.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Build Velocity: Complete 100% of assigned funnel, automation, and workflow builds on time and within scope, tested, with clean handoff docs.

System Uptime: Maintain 99%+ reliability across the GoHighLevel and automation workflows you own, with zero critical failures during launch seasons.

Zero Broken Automations: Monitor your integrations with proactive testing and instant response when a third-party platform changes.

Launch Readiness: Deliver every launch-critical funnel and automation build ahead of go-live, tested end to end.

Documentation: Ship a process map and Loom for 100% of custom builds, kept current as systems change.



SCHEDULE EXPECTATIONS



Your normal schedule is USA CST business hours, 9am – 5pm.



Twice per year we run launch seasons (about 10–12 weeks total) that are high-intensity. During these periods, team members in launch-critical roles are expected to be available from 7am to 7pm, with some extra hours for preparation, live event support, and post-launch debriefs.



This pace is not for everyone, and that's okay. We're clear about it up front so that only people who thrive in a high-accountability, high-impact environment choose to be here. Outside of launch seasons, the workload is sustainable and strategic.



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



Salary: $1,500 to $2,200 USD / month (based on experience). Part-time for the first 2 months, then full-time.

Professional Growth: $1,500 to $3,000 annual budget for courses, certifications, and tools.

Home-Office Setup: Budget to set up your workspace.

Unlimited PTO: Real flexibility with clear boundaries.

Equipment: MacBook, external monitor, and desk equipment provided.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here: 



Applications are initially reviewed using AI-assisted screening tools to check alignment with the role. All hiring decisions are made by humans. The Uncommon Business is an equal opportunity employer.



The Uncommon Business | People-First. Systems-Driven. Built for Scale.

title: Level 2 Helpdesk Technician

About the Position



We are seeking an experienced Level 2 Helpdesk Technician to join our Managed Services team. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience working for a Managed Service Provider (MSP) and be comfortable independently diagnosing and resolving a wide range of technical issues for multiple clients.



This is not a basic entry-level helpdesk position. We are looking for someone who can think independently, troubleshoot problems systematically, and take ownership of tickets from diagnosis through resolution.



The successful candidate must have excellent English communication skills and be able to communicate clearly and professionally with both clients and fellow technicians.



Key Responsibilities

Provide Level 2 technical support to clients via phone,
, remote support, and ticketing systems.

Diagnose and resolve Windows desktop, laptop, application, and connectivity issues.

Troubleshoot DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, networking, and connectivity problems.

Properly document troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and client communications in the PSA.

Manage multiple tickets and priorities while maintaining excellent response and communication standards.

Work independently and take ownership of assigned tickets without requiring constant supervision.

Required Qualifications

Strong hands-on Level 2 troubleshooting experience.

Excellent spoken and written English.

Must be able to communicate clearly and professionally with clients.

DHCP

Windows operating systems

Hardware troubleshooting

Software/application troubleshooting

Microsoft 365

Printers and peripheral devices

Remote access and troubleshooting

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

title: Meta Video Ads Creative Strategist — Hooks & Iterations (Full-Time, Long-Term)

Write hook variations — genuinely different first 3 seconds: visual, voiceover, or structural, not just a new opening line

Repurpose proven creatives across our other products where the angle transfers

Brief our video editors clearly (we have a full editing team — you don't edit)

1+ year with direct-response video ads on Meta

You can read Ads Manager yourself (frequency, CPM, ROAS, CPA) and draw a conclusion from it

Strong written English, organized, responsive on Slack

Nice to have, not required: Shopify or COD offer experience.



What you get



Full-time, 40 hrs/week, long-term role — we're hiring someone to stay, not for a project

One clear area of ownership, direct contact with the founders, real ad budget behind your ideas

Room to grow into broader creative strategy as we scale

Start your subject line with PURPLE-TOE — we filter for it, applications without it aren't seen

In writing: one ad you personally iterated that failed and what you think went wrong, plus your expected monthly rate

title: Vendor Recruitment & Operations Coordinator
description:
FIBI Vacation Rentals is a nationwide full-service short-term rental management company focused on helping real estate investors maximize returns through professional operations, strategic revenue management, and exceptional guest experiences.

We manage properties across multiple states and markets throughout the United States. To support our nationwide footprint, we rely on a large network of independent contractors and service providers who help keep our properties operational, guest-ready, and performing at a high level.

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Vendor Acquisition & Operations Coordinator to oversee vendor recruitment, onboarding, project coordination, claims management, and operational support across our portfolio.

Position Overview

The Vendor Coordinator serves as a critical bridge between onboarding, operations, cleaning coordination, repairs & maintenance, and vendor management.

This role is primarily responsible for building and maintaining our nationwide vendor network by sourcing, interviewing, vetting, onboarding, training, and launching independent contractors into our systems and processes.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable communicating with vendors by phone, able to manage multiple projects simultaneously, and proactive in identifying solutions rather than simply following existing processes.

In addition to vendor acquisition and onboarding, this position supports special projects, utility setup and transfers, damage claim management, and provides cross-functional support to operational departments when needed.

Key Responsibilities

Vendor Recruitment, Vetting & Onboarding

This is the primary responsibility of the role.

Source, recruit, and onboard independent contractors nationwide

Identify qualified cleaners, handymen, maintenance technicians, landscapers, pool technicians, hot tub technicians, inspectors, runners, trash services, and specialty vendors

Research local markets and develop vendor coverage in new and existing service areas

Contact prospective vendors by phone, text,
, and other outreach methods

Conduct vendor interviews and qualification assessments

Gather and compare vendor quotes, pricing, service offerings, and availability

Verify vendor qualifications, insurance, experience, and professionalism

Evaluate vendors against company standards to determine overall fit

Negotiate pricing and service expectations when appropriate

Complete vendor onboarding and documentation requirements

Train vendors on company policies, procedures, quality standards, communication expectations, and software systems

Ensure vendors are fully operational and capable of servicing assigned properties

Build and maintain backup vendor coverage across all active markets

Continuously improve vendor coverage, quality, response times, and operational efficiency throughout the portfolio

Special Projects & Vendor Coordination

Coordinate vendor-related projects for new property onboarding and existing property improvements

Source and obtain quotes from contractors and specialty vendors for repairs, upgrades, installations, furnishing projects, and special initiatives

Serve as the primary point of contact between vendors and internal teams throughout project execution

Coordinate vendor scheduling, communication, and project timelines

Work closely with the Onboarding Team, Interior Design Team, and Operations Team to ensure project goals are achieved

Monitor project progress and proactively address delays or issues

Ensure projects are completed accurately, on time, within budget, and according to scope

Damage Claims & Reimbursement Management

Manage guest damage and reimbursement claims from start to finish

Collect supporting documentation, photos, invoices, videos, vendor estimates, and other evidence

Prepare and submit claims through Airbnb AirCover, Safely, security deposit programs, and other claim platforms

Track claims throughout the review and approval process

Follow up consistently with platforms, insurance providers, vendors, and guests as necessary

Ensure approved claims are paid and properly documented

Identify opportunities to improve claim success rates and recovery amounts

Property Operations Support

Assist with utility account setup, transfers, and service activations for new properties

Coordinate internet, electric, gas, water, trash, and other utility services when requested

Support onboarding projects by coordinating operational vendors and service providers

Cross-train with Cleaning Coordination and Repairs & Maintenance departments

Assist with cleaning, maintenance, and operational workflows during periods of increased volume

Support efforts to ensure properties remain guest-ready and operational at all times

Provide backup support to operational departments when needed

Qualifications

Required

Strong experience recruiting, hiring, vetting, onboarding, and managing independent contractors or vendors

Strong understanding of U.S. residential homes, home systems, and common property maintenance needs

Experience working directly with cleaners, contractors, handymen, maintenance technicians, and service providers

Excellent verbal English communication skills with confidence conducting interviews and vendor calls BY PHONE.

Strong written communication skills

Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities

Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously

Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills

Ability to identify process improvements and proactively solve operational challenges

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

High attention to detail and strong follow-through

Preferred

Experience in short-term rental management, hospitality, property operations, vendor management, or property management

Experience coordinating projects involving multiple vendors and contractors

Experience handling damage claims, insurance, and reimbursements

Familiarity with:

Hostaway

ClickUp

Z-Inspector

Google Workspace

Safely and AirCover claim platforms

Success Looks Like

A successful Vendor Recruitment & Operations Coordinator:

Consistently sources and hires high-quality vendors that meet company standards and budget requirements

Builds and maintains strong vendor coverage and backup coverage across all active markets

Successfully trains and launches vendors into operations with minimal issues

Coordinates projects efficiently while keeping vendors accountable to timelines, scope, and budget

Resolves damage claims accurately and maximizes claim recovery

Serves as a reliable bridge between onboarding, operations, cleaning coordination, and repairs & maintenance teams

Maintains a strong sense of ownership and accountability over assigned projects and responsibilities

Compensation & Benefits

Full-Time (40 Hours Per Week)

PST Schedule Required

100% Remote Position

Long-Term Opportunity

Employee Stock Plan available

$6-$8/hr, depending on experience and skills



To Apply

This will be a TWO-PART APPLICATION PROCESS. To begin the application, please follow these 3 steps, below. Once completed, we will follow up to provide instructions for the second part. The second part will include a working test of your skills.



Please submit:

1. Resume

2. A short video (3 minutes MAX) introducing yourself. You must include the following:

-You must say “Hi FIBI”

-Don’t read an AI-written transcript verbatim

-Briefly describe your experience sourcing vendors

-Describe to me: 3 ways how sourcing a cleaner for an AirBnB/STR property is different from a regular home cleaner.

-Describe to me: 3 options of how you would source an inexpensive, reliable handyman for an STR

-We’re installing an above ground hot tub for an STR in St Louis, MO. List any and all vendors we may need to source for this project to be successfully completed.

-Briefly tell me explicitly if you have YES or NO processed damage claims on AirBnB and/or Safely

title: Social Media Creative Developer & Community Builder
description:
We are seeking a highly creative Social Media Creative Developer & Community Builder to build and grow the digital presence of an expanding Emotional Intelligence and personal development company.



This is not simply a social media posting position.



We are looking for someone who can take an established brand, mission, and creative direction and transform it into a professional, engaging, cohesive social media presence and online community.



You must be able to take direction extremely well while also bringing your own creativity, ideas, and expertise to the position.



Our goal is not to have someone waiting for us to tell them exactly what graphic to create or what to post every day. We want someone who can understand our vision, learn our content deeply, and then use their creative abilities to help bring that vision to life.



ABOUT OUR WORK



Our flagship program is a 16-week Emotional Intelligence program focused on emotional awareness, behavioral patterns, communication, accountability, healthier decision-making, relationships, and long-term behavioral change.



Because of the nature of our work, a strong understanding of Emotional Intelligence is required.



You should be genuinely comfortable working with psychology, personal development, emotional awareness, behavior change, relationships, vulnerability, communication, and similar subject matter.



We do not want someone simply copying quotes about Emotional Intelligence from the internet. You need to understand the concepts well enough to creatively communicate them.



WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



You will help develop our social media presence from the ground up, including strategy, creative development, content creation, posting, organization, and community development.



Responsibilities will include:



-Creating social media content for
, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn.

-Developing graphics, carousels, short-form videos, reels, educational content, promotional content, engagement posts, and other creative assets.

-Taking existing educational material and transforming it into engaging social content.

-Maintaining a consistent visual identity, voice, message, and brand across platforms.

-Helping determine how content should be adapted differently for
, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn rather than simply posting identical content everywhere.

-Developing content ideas and identifying creative opportunities independently.

-Helping establish and grow our social media presence and audience.

-Creating and organizing content calendars.

-Developing strategies to increase meaningful engagement and community participation.

-Tracking what content performs well and using that information to improve future content.

-Helping build and develop a new Kajabi Community for our clients and participants.

-Creating an organized, engaging, welcoming experience inside the Kajabi Community.

-Helping develop community content, discussions, announcements, engagement strategies, and ongoing participant interaction.

-Working collaboratively with the founder while also being capable of independently executing approved ideas.



PLATFORM EXPERIENCE

Applicants should have professional experience with:



Kajabi


Instagram

TikTok

LinkedIn



Experience with Canva and/or professional creative design and video-editing platforms is also expected.



Kajabi experience is especially important. Please be specific about what you have personally created, managed, or developed within Kajabi.



CREATIVE ABILITY IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT

We are looking for someone with a strong creative instinct who can look at a piece of information and immediately begin thinking:



How can I turn this into compelling content?



That might mean a carousel one day, a short-form video another day, an educational graphic, an interactive community discussion, a story, a campaign, or an entirely new idea we haven't considered.



We want someone who can bring ideas to us — not someone who only waits for assignments.



At the same time, being able to take direction is essential.



Creativity does not mean ignoring the established brand or changing the message. You must be able to listen carefully, understand feedback, make revisions without resistance, and creatively work within the direction and identity of the brand.



EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate that they have actually built something.



We want to see examples of social media accounts, brands, communities, or platforms that you personally helped develop — especially those you helped build from the beginning or during an early growth stage.



Ideal candidates will have:



-Professional social media content creation and development experience.

-Experience building social media accounts from the ground up.

-A strong portfolio demonstrating creative range.

-Experience creating both written and visual social content.

-Short-form video/reel experience.

-Strong understanding of social media engagement and audience development.

-Experience developing or managing online communities.

-Hands-on Kajabi experience.

-Strong written English and communication skills.

-Excellent attention to detail.

-A deep understanding of Emotional Intelligence.

-The ability to take feedback and direction.

-The ability to work independently once direction has been established.

-Strong organizational and time-management skills.



THE TYPE OF PERSON WE WANT

We are looking for someone who is:

Creative. Curious. Organized. Reliable. Emotionally intelligent. Coachable. Self-motivated.



You should be someone who can receive a direction such as:



"This is what we're teaching this month, this is the message we're trying to communicate, and this is the feeling I want the brand to create."



Then take that information and develop multiple strong creative ideas for how to communicate it.



We want someone who notices opportunities, brings ideas forward, asks thoughtful questions, solves problems, and takes ownership of their work.



TO APPLY



Please do not send only a résumé.



We need to see your creative ability and previous work.



Please include:



-Links to 3–5 social media accounts, brands, communities, or platforms you have personally worked on.

-Identify which examples you helped build from the ground up and explain exactly what you were responsible for.

-Show us examples of graphics, carousels, reels, TikToks, videos, campaigns, or other content you personally created.

-Tell us about your experience using Kajabi, including any communities, courses, websites, or other Kajabi features you have personally built or managed.

-Tell us which platforms you have professionally managed:
, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and/or others.

-Describe your role in developing the social media strategy for one of the accounts you have shared.

-In your own words, explain what Emotional Intelligence means to you and how you would approach creating social media content about Emotional Intelligence without making it feel generic or repetitive.

-Give us an example of a time a client or manager gave you creative direction that was different from what you originally envisioned. How did you handle the feedback?

-Tell us about one social media or community project where you were given a general goal and developed the creative direction yourself.



Applications without examples or links to previous work will not be considered.



We are interested in seeing what you have actually created and what role you personally played in creating it. Please do not submit work created primarily by another member of a team without clearly explaining your contribution.



POSITION DETAILS



Part-time position to start with the opportunity of shifting to more hours your position unfolds.

title: Automate Our Law Firm

title: Dispute & Chargeback Prevention Manager
description:
# Dispute & Chargeback Prevention Manager



**Salary:** $5/hour

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Role:** Remote



## About the Role



We are looking for an experienced **Dispute & Chargeback Prevention Manager** to take full ownership of customer disputes, PayPal claims, credit card chargebacks, and backend payment-risk operations across our eCommerce stores.



This is a hands-on role for someone who understands how **PayPal disputes, credit card chargebacks, and payment processor disputes** work and knows how to prevent disputes before they happen, resolve customer issues proactively, and build strong evidence packages when a dispute or chargeback is filed.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and experienced in managing disputes from start to finish.



## Key Responsibilities



### Chargeback & Dispute Prevention



* Monitor orders and customer issues that could potentially result in disputes or chargebacks.

* Identify high-risk or problematic orders before they escalate.

* Proactively communicate with customers to resolve delivery, product, refund, or service issues.

* Work closely with customer support and operations to resolve complaints before customers contact PayPal or their bank.

* Maintain accurate records of refunds, replacements, tracking information, customer communications, and resolutions.

* Identify recurring reasons for disputes and recommend improvements to reduce future chargebacks.



### PayPal Dispute Management



* Manage **PayPal disputes, claims, and escalations** from start to finish.

* Investigate each case and determine the appropriate response.

* Prepare strong and well-organized evidence packages.

* Submit dispute responses within PayPal's deadlines.

* Track open cases, deadlines, responses, and outcomes.

* Analyze successful and unsuccessful cases to continuously improve the dispute process.



### Credit Card Chargeback Management



* Manage **credit card disputes and chargebacks** filed through banks and card networks.

* Investigate chargeback reason codes and determine why the customer disputed the transaction.

* Collect and organize supporting evidence, including:



  * Order details

  * Customer communications

  * Shipping and tracking information

  * Delivery confirmation

  * Product information

  * Refund/replacement records

  * Payment information

  * Checkout/order information

  * Relevant terms and policies

* Prepare clear, accurate, and compelling chargeback responses.

* Submit responses within processor deadlines.

* Monitor chargeback outcomes and maintain detailed records of wins and losses.

* Identify recurring chargeback reasons and recommend preventive measures.



### Backend Dispute Operations



* Maintain a centralized **dispute and chargeback tracking system**.

* Track every case, including:



  * Customer

  * Order number

  * Dispute/chargeback reason

  * Amount

  * Payment method

  * Deadline

  * Evidence submitted

  * Current status

  * Outcome

* Make sure no dispute deadline is missed.

* Coordinate with customer support, fulfillment, suppliers, and management when additional information is required.

* Escalate serious, unusual, or high-value cases to management.

* Maintain accurate documentation for every customer/payment issue.

* Prepare regular reports showing dispute volume, chargeback rate, win rate, losses, and common dispute reasons.



## What We Are Looking For



* **Strong previous experience managing PayPal disputes and credit card chargebacks.**

* Practical understanding of how payment disputes and chargebacks work.

* Experience preparing evidence and successfully winning disputes.

* Experience with PayPal and other payment processors.

* Experience handling **credit card chargebacks/disputes through payment processors or merchant platforms**.

* Strong understanding of chargeback reason codes and evidence requirements.

* Proven ability to prevent customer complaints from becoming chargebacks.

* Excellent organizational and documentation skills.

* Extremely strong attention to detail.

* Ability to manage a large number of cases without missing deadlines.

* Comfortable working with Shopify, Google Sheets, customer support platforms, payment processors, and eCommerce tools.

* Strong written English.

* Ability to investigate problems independently and make practical decisions.

* Experience with eCommerce, dropshipping, or online retail is highly preferred.



## What Makes a Great Candidate



We are **not looking for someone who simply responds to chargebacks after they happen.**



We want someone who understands the complete process:



**Identify the problem → Contact the customer → Resolve the issue → Prevent the dispute → If a dispute occurs, investigate it → Build the evidence → Submit the response → Track the outcome → Learn from the case.**



The ideal candidate should think proactively about **reducing chargebacks**, while also maximizing the chances of winning legitimate disputes that have already been filed.



## Compensation



**$5/hour**



The position may grow into a larger operational role based on performance, organization, dispute win rates, and measurable improvements in chargeback prevention.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Your previous experience with **PayPal disputes**.

2. Your previous experience with **credit card chargebacks**.

3. Which payment processors/platforms you have worked with.

4. Your experience with chargeback prevention.

5. Your experience preparing dispute evidence.

6. The types of eCommerce businesses/stores you have worked with.

7. Your previous role and responsibilities.

8. Your availability and time zone.

9. Your experience using Shopify, Google Sheets, payment processors, or customer support platforms.



**Candidates with proven PayPal and credit card chargeback experience will receive priority.**

title: Outbound Cold Calling & Appointment Setter – B2B Sales Hunter
description:
Outbound Cold Calling & Appointment Setter – B2B Sales Hunter



Full Time | Monday–Friday | 9:00am–5:00pm Perth, Western Australia Time



QPC Group is an established Australian office technology company providing Managed Print Services, printers and photocopiers, VoIP phone systems and other business technology solutions.



We are looking for an experienced B2B outbound cold caller and appointment setter.



This is a pure HUNTER role.



There are ZERO leads provided to you.



You will be responsible for researching your target market, building your own prospect lists, identifying the correct decision-makers, cold calling businesses and generating qualified appointments for our Australian Sales Team.



If your experience is primarily answering inbound calls, working supplied leads or calling warm databases, this role is not for you.



What You Will Do



You will be given the industries and target markets we want to pursue.



From there, you own the process.



You will be responsible for:



* Researching businesses within our target markets.

* Creating and maintaining your own prospecting lists.

* Using LinkedIn and other online sources to research businesses.

* Identifying the correct decision-maker within each organisation.

* Understanding which job titles to target depending on the business.

* Finding IT Managers, IT Directors, Owners, General Managers, Purchasing/Procurement Officers, Office Managers and other relevant decision-makers.

* Researching names, company details, phone numbers and other useful information before calling.

* Calling businesses completely cold.

* Asking for the decision-maker by name wherever possible, rather than simply asking reception who handles something.

* Navigating receptionists and gatekeepers professionally.

* Speaking confidently with Australian businesses.

* Starting conversations and uncovering opportunities.

* Identifying pain points and potential requirements.

* Generating qualified leads.

* Booking appointments directly for our Sales Team.

* Recording accurate prospect and call information.

* Following up prospects when appropriate.



This Is 100% Outbound Cold Calling



We want to be extremely clear about this.



We will NOT provide you with leads to call.



You need to know how to go from:



Target Market → Research → Company → Decision-Maker → Contact Details → Cold Call → Conversation → Qualified Appointment



We are looking for someone who has done this extensively before.



You need to genuinely enjoy prospecting and cold calling.



You should be comfortable hearing “no”, making another call and continuing until you find an opportunity.



We don’t want someone who waits for leads.



We want a hunter who creates them.



You Must Have



* Extensive previous B2B outbound cold-calling experience.

* Proven appointment-setting experience.

* Experience creating your own prospecting/call lists.

* Strong LinkedIn research skills.

* Ability to identify decision-makers based on job titles and company structures.

* Excellent spoken English.

* Confidence speaking with Australian business customers.

* Strong communication and questioning skills.

* Experience navigating gatekeepers.

* Ability to work independently.

* Strong research skills.

* Confidence working to activity and appointment targets.

* Resilience and persistence.



Please only apply if you have extensive experience doing this type of work.



Working Hours



This is a full-time position:



Monday to Friday

9:00am – 5:00pm Perth, Western Australia time



You must be available for the full shift.



IMPORTANT – Voice Recording Required



Because this is a telephone-based sales position, your voice recording is an essential part of your application.



Please record yourself delivering the following as though you were speaking to a real Australian business prospect:



“Hi, my name is [YOUR NAME] from QPC Group. We are an office technology company. We provide managed print services and VoIP phone systems. I’d love to know which one’s your biggest pain point in your office to see how we can help you today.”



Don’t rush through it or simply read the words.



We want to hear your natural telephone voice, confidence, energy and spoken English.



How to Apply



Your application MUST have the following subject line:



Outbound Sales Genius



Please include:



1. Your voice recording using the script above.

2. A summary of your previous B2B cold-calling and appointment-setting experience.

3. Explain how you have previously built your own prospect lists and found decision-makers.

4. Your CV/resume.

5. Your internet speeds and backup plan for power and internet outages .

6. Confirmation that you can work Monday–Friday, 8:00am–5:00pm Perth time.



Minimum Apply Points: 3



Applications using fewer than 3 Apply Points will not be considered.



If you’re an experienced outbound salesperson who knows how to research a market, find the right person, pick up the phone and create opportunities from absolutely nothing, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Local SEO Strategist
description:

Position: Part-Time (Remote)

Location: Philippines (required)

Compensation: Competitive hourly rate based on experience

Start Date: ASAP



Narratives by Nazar is a fast-growing digital marketing agency specializing in helping service-based businesses dominate their local markets. We specialize in elevating women-focused service businesses, especially in the aesthetics, wellness, beauty, and lifestyle space. Our mission is to help conscious, service-driven brands grow with integrity, clarity, and confidence.



We’re looking for an experienced Local SEO Strategist who can take ownership of client SEO performance from strategy through execution and optimization. This is not a task-based SEO assistant role, and we are not looking for someone who needs a detailed checklist for every step. We want someone who can look at a client’s business, market, website, Google Business Profile, competitors, and performance data and determine:

- What should we prioritize?

- What is holding this client back?

- Where is the biggest opportunity?

- What should we test or change?

- What work should be assigned to the content writer or developer?

- Is our current strategy actually producing results?



You should be comfortable owning the SEO roadmap, making recommendations, setting priorities, coordinating implementation, and adjusting strategy based on results. You will be responsible for running campaigns from the ground up, with support from our content writer and developer.



We believe in:

- Transparency over tactics

- Long-term relationships over short-term hacks

- Human-centered strategy guided by data and intent

- Empowering women-owned businesses to scale sustainably

- Creativity supported by systems so clients can grow without chaos



We work closely with founders, providers, and local service business owners who value authenticity as much as results. Your work directly impacts real people building real livelihoods, not faceless enterprises.



Who We’re Looking For:

- An experienced Local SEO specialist with a strong portfolio of measurable results at an agency (you will need to provide examples of past work)

- Someone who understands ranking local service providers (not eCommerce, not national SEO) for Google SERPs and Maps, including off-page SEO tactics

- A system-driven thinker who enjoys optimizing processes

- A problem solver who takes ownership of outcomes

- Comfortable working remotely and independently

- Eager to grow with a mission-driven, values-led creative agency



Core Responsibilities:

As a Local SEO Strategist & Implementor, your responsibilities include but are not limited to:



1. OWN LOCAL SEO STRATEGY

You will be responsible for developing and continuously improving the Local SEO strategy for assigned clients.



This includes:

- Evaluating each client’s current Local SEO position, competitive landscape, and growth opportunities

- Developing tailored Local SEO strategies primarily for service-based businesses, with occasional e-commerce clients

- Conducting keyword, SERP, market, and competitor research

- Identifying the highest-impact opportunities and setting priorities

- Building SEO roadmaps rather than waiting for individual tasks to be assigned

- Conducting website and Google Business Profile audits

- Determining what content, technical improvements, GBP optimizations, citations, links, or other initiatives are needed

- Reviewing existing strategies and challenging them when the data suggests a better direction

- Regularly bringing forward new opportunities, concerns, and recommendations



You should be able to take a client account and confidently determine what needs to happen next without being micromanaged.



2. DRIVE GOOGLE BUSINESS PROFILE & LOCAL VISIBILITY STRATEGY

You will own the strategy behind improving each client’s local search and Google Maps visibility.



Responsibilities may include:

- Evaluating and optimizing Google Business Profiles

- Developing recommendations around categories, services, descriptions, photos, posts, attributes, and other GBP features

- Identifying opportunities to improve Maps visibility

- Managing citation strategy, setup, and cleanup using BrightLocal or similar tools

- Conducting NAP audits and identifying inconsistencies

- Determining which citation opportunities are worth pursuing

- Tracking local visibility and identifying patterns in ranking performance

- Developing recommendations based on GBP insights and local ranking data

- Overseeing weekly GBP posting through BrightLocal



Please include BLUE SKY in your application headline so we know you reviewed the full job post.



3. LEAD ON-PAGE SEO DIRECTION

You will identify what needs to change on client websites to improve local organic performance.



Responsibilities include:

- Developing on-page SEO recommendations for service and location pages

- Creating or reviewing title tags, headings, metadata, internal linking, and content structure

- Identifying content gaps and opportunities

- Creating recommendations for new service pages, location pages, supporting content, or other assets when necessary

- Reviewing SEO content produced by our content team

- Providing the writer with clear briefs, keyword targets, search intent, page goals, and strategic direction

- Reviewing completed content to ensure it supports the broader SEO strategy

- Writing or overseeing schema markup such as JSON-LD where appropriate



You do not need to personally write every piece of content. Your responsibility is to make sure the right content is being created for the right strategic reason.



4. IDENTIFY & OVERSEE TECHNICAL SEO IMPROVEMENTS

This role does not require you to be a developer, but you should understand enough technical SEO to identify problems and direct our developer effectively.



Responsibilities include:

- Identifying crawlability, indexing, architecture, internal linking, and page experience issues

- Spotting technical problems that may be limiting organic performance

- Prioritizing technical fixes based on SEO impact

- Providing clear implementation instructions to our WordPress developer

- Reviewing completed fixes to ensure they were implemented correctly

- Following up when technical issues remain unresolved



You should be able to translate an SEO problem into a clear recommendation the developer can execute.



5. OWN PERFORMANCE & CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

We do not want someone who implements an SEO plan and then simply watches rankings.



You will be expected to actively evaluate whether the strategy is working.



Responsibilities include:

- Monitoring keyword rankings, traffic, leads, conversions, GBP performance, and local visibility

- Reviewing Search Console, Analytics, GBP, and ranking data for meaningful trends

- Identifying what is working and what is not

- Investigating unexpected ranking or traffic changes

- Adjusting priorities based on performance

- Developing hypotheses and recommendations when campaigns stall

- Preparing concise monthly performance reports

- Clearly communicating wins, challenges, next steps, and strategic recommendations

- Proactively identifying opportunities that were not part of the original roadmap



We expect you to think beyond the report and tell us what the data means and what we should do because of it.



Additional Information

Tools You Should Be Fluent In:

- Google Business Profile

- Google Analytics & Search Console

- BrightLocal, Whitespark, or similar citation tools

- Keyword research tools (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Ubersuggest, etc.)

- Schema generators or hand-written JSON-LD

- WordPress familiarity (no coding; dev provided)



Job Requirements:

- 2+ years professional experience in Local SEO (agency experience preferred)

- Strong English communication skills

- Ability to work part-time with consistent availability and meet for 1-2 hours a week on a consistent schedule during our operating hours.

- Process-oriented and able to document workflows

- Comfortable collaborating with a content writer and developer



Work Style & Collaboration

- This is a remote, independent role with flexible working hours

- Availability is required for 1-2 hours of meetings per week during operating hours

- You will collaborate closely with the Founder, content writers, and developer

- Clear communication, documentation, and process adherence are expected

- Part-time to start (5 hours per week to start, with opportunity to expand to 20)

- Growth potential into a larger, more strategic role





Please send:

- Your resume

- A short note explaining your Local SEO experience

- Portfolio of your past work

- Examples of service-based businesses you’ve ranked (please include their URL)

- Tools you’re most comfortable working with

- Your expected hourly rate

title: Remote Operations and Client Support Aissitant
description:
JOB TITLE: Remote Operations and Client Support Assistant



COMPANY: Turnkey Linen Hire

LOCATION: Remote – Philippines

HOURS: Part-time initially, with the potential to increase

WORKING HOURS: UK daytime hours on an agreed rota. Weekend availability is essential, and the successful applicant must be available to work on both Saturdays and Sundays. Regular days off can be arranged during the week.

SALARY: To be agreed based on experience



ABOUT TURNKEY



Turnkey Linen Hire is a growing UK-based company providing linen hire, cleaning and property changeover services to Airbnb hosts, short-let operators and property managers across Greater Manchester and surrounding areas.



We manage multiple properties and cleaning teams, so we are looking for a dependable and highly organised Remote Operations and Client Support Assistant to help coordinate our day-to-day services.



This is not a passive administration role. Our cleans take place seven days a week and are time-sensitive. The successful applicant must be comfortable following up with cleaners, checking that work has been completed and responding quickly when a problem arises.



THE ROLE



You will support the daily running of our Airbnb cleaning and linen-hire operations. Your main responsibility will be ensuring that scheduled cleans are confirmed, monitored and properly documented.



You will communicate regularly with our cleaners, clients and management team through WhatsApp,
 and property-management platforms such as Turno and Guesty.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Daily scheduling and cleaner coordination:



Review the upcoming cleaning schedule.

Send cleaners their rotas and property information.

Confirm that cleaners have received and accepted their assigned jobs.

Remind cleaners about outstanding or upcoming assignments.

Monitor whether cleaners have started and completed jobs on time.

Contact cleaners when they are late or have not provided an update.

Report absences, delays or potential scheduling problems promptly.

Help contact available cleaners when emergency cover is required.

Monitor weekend cleans with the same level of attention as weekday cleans.

Clean completion and quality checks:



Confirm that every scheduled clean has been completed.

Ensure cleaners submit all required before-and-after photographs.

Check that photographs are clear, complete and assigned to the correct property.

Gather photographs received through WhatsApp and upload them to the relevant client platform.

Upload completion notes and images to Turno, Guesty or other client systems.

Check that required cleaning checklists have been completed.

Follow up with cleaners when photographs, checklists or completion information are missing.

Escalate any evidence of damage, missing items, maintenance problems or poor cleaning standards.

Customer and client support:



Monitor and respond to routine client messages and enquiries.

Provide updates regarding the progress or completion of cleans.

Use approved message templates to answer common questions.

Communicate professionally and confidently with clients.

Escalate complaints, refund requests, pricing questions and serious service issues to management.

Keep accurate records of client requests and follow-up actions.

Administration:



Maintain accurate cleaning schedules, property records and contact information.

Update internal trackers and operational spreadsheets.

Record cleaner availability, absences and changes to assigned work.

Ensure property access instructions and cleaning notes remain current.

Organise client photographs, documents and messages correctly.

Prepare a concise end-of-day report covering completed cleans, outstanding actions, problems and decisions required.

FUTURE RESPONSIBILITIES



Once you understand the business and our services, the position may expand to include:



Following up with prospective clients.

Researching Airbnb hosts, property managers and short-let operators.

Sending approved introductory messages and service information.

Maintaining a lead and follow-up tracker.

Promoting our linen hire, cleaning and turnover-pack services.

Booking sales calls and appointments for management.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE



The successful applicant must have:



Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong organisational and time-management skills.

Experience as a Virtual Assistant, Operations Assistant, Property Management Assistant or Customer Support Assistant.

Confidence communicating with workers and clients.

The ability to follow up persistently while remaining polite and professional.

Excellent attention to detail, particularly when checking property names, dates, photographs and client instructions.

The ability to prioritise urgent tasks and respond calmly when plans change.

Experience using WhatsApp,
, Google Drive, Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel.

A reliable computer, stable internet connection and suitable home-working environment.

Availability during agreed UK daytime hours.

Reliable availability on both Saturdays and Sundays.

Willingness to have regular days off during the week rather than at weekends.

Willingness to learn Turno, Guesty and our internal systems.

DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE



The following would be advantageous:



Previous experience supporting an Airbnb, short-let, cleaning or property-management business.

Experience using Turno, Guesty, Airbnb, 
 or similar platforms.

Experience coordinating cleaners, contractors or remote workers.

Customer-service or complaint-handling experience.

Lead generation, outreach or appointment-setting experience.

Familiarity with UK customers and UK business communication.

THE RIGHT PERSON



We are looking for someone who is:



Dependable and punctual.

Proactive rather than waiting to be told about every task.

Comfortable chasing missing information.

Calm and resourceful when problems arise.

Confident enough to ask questions when something is unclear.

Careful with confidential client, guest and property information.

Able to follow established procedures consistently.

Interested in growing with the company and taking on greater responsibility.

PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



Success in this role means:



Cleaners receive and confirm their rotas on time.

Scheduled cleans are actively monitored seven days a week.

Missing updates and photographs are followed up promptly.

Images and completion information are uploaded to the correct platforms.

Routine client enquiries receive timely, professional responses.

Problems are identified and escalated before they become serious.

Management receives an accurate end-of-day operational summary.

HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following in your application:



A short introduction explaining your relevant experience.

Details of any work you have completed for a cleaning, Airbnb, short-let or property-management company.

The software and property-management platforms you have previously used.

Confirmation that you can work UK daytime hours on Saturdays and Sundays.

Your preferred weekday days off.

Your expected hourly or monthly salary.

Your internet speed and details of any backup internet or power arrangements.

A short answer to the scenario below.

APPLICATION SCENARIO



You are monitoring five property cleans on a Sunday. One cleaner has not arrived, another has completed a clean but has not sent photographs, and a client is asking whether their property is ready for a guest arriving shortly.



Please explain:



Which issue you would handle first and why.

What action you would take for each issue.

What messages you would send to the cleaners and the client.

Please begin your application with the words “TURNKEY OPERATIONS” so we know you have read the complete job description.



Weekend work is an essential part of this position. Please do not apply if you are unable to work reliably during UK daytime hours on Saturdays and Sundays, or if you are uncomfortable making follow-up calls and sending reminders to cleaners.

title: Video Editor
description:
Video Editor — Part-Time (Remote)

$5 USD per video + performance bonuses  |  Work from home  |  Flexible hours

About the Role

We create short-form video content for social media. We are looking for editors to join our team on a per-video basis.

You will be given everything you need — scripts, footage, and a full training course showing you exactly how we want the videos made. You are not expected to come up with ideas or write anything. Your job is to edit.

There is no fixed schedule. You make as many videos as you want, whenever you want.

How the Pay Works

$5 USD per completed video.

There is no limit on how many videos you can make. If you make 10 videos in a week, you get paid for 10. If you make 40, you get paid for 40.

Payment date: the 1st of every month, for all videos completed in the previous month.

Performance bonuses: on top of your $5 per video, you earn bonuses based on how well your videos perform. The better your videos do, the more you earn. This is explained in full during training.



Growth Opportunity

This starts as a part-time role.

If you do well — good quality, consistent output, reliable — there is a clear path to a full-time position paying $1,000–$2,000 USD per month.

We would much rather promote someone already on the team than hire from outside. Several of our people started exactly here.



Requirements

You must have a PC. This role cannot be done on a phone or tablet. A laptop or desktop computer is essential.

Stable internet connection. You will be downloading and uploading video files daily.

Basic video editing experience. You do not need to be an expert. If you can cut clips, add captions and sync audio, we can teach you the rest.

Good written English. Enough to read a script and understand feedback.

You must complete our training course before you make any videos. It takes 2–3 hours. This is unpaid, but it teaches you exactly what we want, and it is the difference between earning a little and earning a lot on this job.



What You Will Be Doing

Editing short-form videos (30 seconds to 3 minutes) for social media

Following a script we provide

Adding captions, B-roll and music to our standard

Making small changes when we give feedback

Delivering finished videos ready to post

Who This Suits

This is a good fit if you want flexible work you can fit around other commitments, and you want your income to depend on how much you put in rather than how many hours you sit at a desk.

It is not a good fit if you need a fixed monthly salary from day one, or if you want to work from a phone.



How to Apply

Reply to this message with:

Your name and where you are based

Whatsapp#

What editing software you use

Links to 2–3 videos you have edited (any short-form work is fine)

Confirmation that you have a PC

Roughly how many hours a week you could commit

We reply to everyone. If you are a fit, we will send you the training course and get you started straight away.

We're looking for a graphic designer for ongoing
 and Instagram ad campaigns.

The biggest thing we're looking for is someone who can study our previous designer's work and match that same level of quality.



1. Review Our Previous Designer's Work

Please review the graphics in the folder below:

Previous Designer Examples:


 


  



Pay attention to:

Layout and composition

Typography

Text hierarchy

Colors and branding

Image placement

Effects and graphics

Overall polish



If hired, you'll be working with several different clients, so it's important that you can adapt your designs to each client's branding.



That means understanding how to use their colors, fonts, logos, photos, and overall visual style while maintaining the quality of our existing ads.



2. Your Test Project



For this test, I want you to REMAKE ONE GRAPHIC FROM EACH ABOVE FOLDER (TWO IMAGES IN TOTAL). 



You can choose any roofing company you find online to use for the remake.



Keep the same words, offer, and overall design/layout from our example, but redesign it for the roofing company you selected.

For example, if their branding uses blue and white, your version should use their blue and white.



Use that company's:

Logo

Brand colors

Fonts or similar fonts

Photos/images when available

Overall branding



The goal is to show us that you can take an existing design and adapt it to a completely different company's brand while maintaining the same quality.



PLEASE CREATE ONE IMAGE FROM EACH OF OUR EXAMPLE FOLDERS. CHOOSE THE ONES THAT ALLOW YOU TO DEMONSTRATE YOUR ABILITY THE BEST. 



3. How Our Normal Projects Work

If hired, we typically create 4–6 graphics per campaign.



We'll usually provide an AI-generated mockup showing you the concept and general direction.

Your job is to turn that mockup into a polished, professional ad.



This includes:

Incorporating the client's real photos

Fixing AI mistakes

Improving typography and spacing

Correcting unrealistic details

Applying the client's actual branding

Making general design improvements



The AI mockup is a starting point, not the finished design.

We want you to use your skills as a designer to make it better.



4. Time Expectations

Most graphics should take approximately 1–3 hours per image, depending on complexity.

We're looking for quality and attention to detail, not someone rushing through designs.

If hired, this will be consistent, ongoing work across multiple clients.





TO APPLY:

Remake ONE graphic from EACH example folder using any roofing company you find online.



Use the same words and general design from our example, but adapt it to the roofing company's colors, fonts, logo, images, and branding.



Send us your finished graphic along with your application.



We're looking forward to seeing what you can do!
