title: Back Office Administration & Customer Support Assistant
description:
We are an established Australian technology company looking for a reliable, organised and proactive Back Office Administration & Customer Support Assistant to join our team full-time.



This is an all-rounder position.



We are looking for someone who enjoys getting things done and is happy to take ownership of all the small but important jobs that keep a business running smoothly.



Your responsibilities will vary from day to day and may include:



Accounts Receivable / Debtor Follow-Up



* Review overdue customer accounts.

*
 customers regarding outstanding invoices.

* Call customers to politely follow up overdue accounts.

* Confirm customers have received their invoices.

* Ask when payment can be expected.

* Take appropriate notes and follow up when required.

* Escalate any account issues to our Australian team.

* Where appropriate, ask whether the customer would like to make payment by credit card over the phone.



You must be confident speaking with Australian customers over the phone and have excellent spoken English.



Customer Monitoring & Administration



We have automated monitoring systems connected to our customers’ equipment.



You will:



* Review alerts and reports identifying customers whose monitoring connection has stopped or gone stale.

* Contact the customer using our existing
 templates.

* Ask them to check or reconnect the monitoring software.

* Follow up outstanding connections.

* Keep our systems and records updated.

* Escalate issues that require technical assistance.



You do not need to be highly technical. We will provide processes, templates and training.



Support Ticket Assistance



You may also assist with our customer support ticket system.



This includes:



* Reviewing incoming support tickets.

* Understanding what the customer is asking.

* Searching our existing knowledge base for the appropriate solution.

* Responding using approved or predetermined answers where possible.

* Gathering additional information from the customer when required.

* Escalating tickets to our technical team when they require specialist assistance.



The objective is to resolve simple requests and gather the necessary information before our technical team needs to become involved.



Research & Knowledge Base



You may be asked to:



* Research solutions to common questions.

* Develop draft answers for frequently asked questions.

* Create and update knowledge-base articles.

* Document processes and procedures.

* Use AI tools to assist with research, drafting and administration.

* Turn information provided by our team into clear instructions or customer-facing responses.



General Administration



This is a genuine “whatever needs doing” back-office role.



Other tasks may include:



* Data entry and database maintenance.

* Updating customer records.

* Preparing spreadsheets and reports.

* Checking information for accuracy.

* Following up customers, suppliers or internal staff.

*
 administration.

* Internet research.

* Preparing documents.

* Checking systems and reports.

* Completing repetitive administrative tasks.

* Assisting our Australian team with ad-hoc projects and tasks.



If something needs to be researched, checked, followed up, documented or completed, we want someone who is willing to take ownership of it.



Who We Are Looking For



You should have:



* Excellent spoken and written English.

* Confidence speaking with Australian customers by telephone.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Good computer and internet skills.

* Strong organisational skills.

* Professional and friendly communication.

* Ability to follow documented procedures.

* Ability to research and find answers independently.

* Confidence using AI tools such as ChatGPT.

* Ability to learn new software quickly.

* Good judgement about when you can handle something yourself and when it needs to be escalated.

* A proactive attitude – we don’t want someone who needs to be told every small step.

* Reliable internet and a suitable home working environment.



Previous experience in administration, accounts receivable, customer service, helpdesk, office administration or virtual assistance would be highly regarded.



Working Hours



This is a full-time position.



Monday to Friday

9:00am – 5:00pm Perth, Western Australia time



You must be available during these hours as you will be communicating with our customers and Australian team.



IMPORTANT – Voice Recording Required



Because this role involves speaking with our customers, applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



Please send us a short voice recording saying the following:



“Hi, this is [YOUR NAME] from QPC Group. I’m just giving you a quick call regarding your account. It looks like there are a couple of invoices that are now overdue. I just wanted to check that you’ve received the invoices and see when we can expect payment. If it’s easier, we can also arrange payment by credit card over the phone.”



Please speak naturally as though you were actually talking to one of our customers – don’t just read the script as quickly as possible.



How to Apply



Please send us:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Your previous experience relevant to this position.

3. Your resume/CV.

4. Your voice recording using the script above.

5. Details of your internet connection and home working setup.

6. Back up internet and power plan

7. Confirmation that you can work 9:00am–5:00pm Perth, Western Australia time, Monday to Friday.

8. When applying ensure you have your voice recording, the subject line says “Back office Baby!” And a minimum of 3 Apply Points.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a reliable long-term member of our team, learn our business and gradually take ownership of more back-office responsibilities.

title: Outbound Sales Assistant
description:
We are a small business in the UK that provides data training and consultancy to humanitarian and international development organisations. We help organisations collect, manage, analyse and communicate their data better, with particular expertise in tools such as KoBoToolbox, Power BI, Excel and QGIS.



In this job, you'll work closely with the founder and help us build and test new ways of finding customers and developing partnerships.



THE ROLE:

We're looking for a proactive, organised Virtual Assistant to support our sales and partnership development.



Initially, we'll be running a series of structured tests to understand which approaches are most effective for generating new business.



Two of the main areas you'll support are:

1) Outbound sales - identifying relevant organisations and people, researching potential customers, managing prospect lists, supporting outreach and follow-up, and keeping our CRM organised.

2) Partnership development - researching organisations that could become partners, identifying the right people to approach, supporting outreach and follow-up, and helping us track conversations and opportunities.



You won't be expected to close sales yourself.

Instead, your job is to make sure the sales process happens consistently and systematically, until it reaches the point where it makes sense for the founder to become involved.



YOUR WORK:

- Researching humanitarian, development, NGO, donor, consultancy and related organisations that fit agreed criteria.

- Identifying relevant decision-makers and finding accurate contact information.

- Building and maintaining prospect and partner lists.

- Researching organisations before outreach so that messages can be relevant rather than generic spam.

- Sending personalised outreach using agreed templates and processes.

- Following up consistently with people who haven't responded.

- Responding to straightforward replies and flagging conversations that need the founder's involvement.

- Booking calls with qualified prospects and potential partners.

- Keeping our CRM accurate and up to date.

- Recording where every lead came from and what happened.

- Helping prepare simple information or materials for prospects and partners.

- Tracking weekly activity and results.

- Helping us improve our processes as we learn what works.



We'll track results as follows:

- Suitable prospects identified

- People contacted

- Response rate

- Positive responses

- Qualified conversations generated

- Calls booked

- Customers generated (you won't be responsible for this)

- Revenue generated (you won't be responsible for this)



YOUR SKILLS:

- Have excellent written English.

- Are extremely organised and reliable.

- Are comfortable researching organisations and people online.

- Can follow a process carefully without needing constant supervision.

- Have good judgement about whether an organisation or person actually fits the criteria you've been given.

- Are confident working with spreadsheets and CRM systems.

- Are comfortable sending professional
s and messages.

- Follow up without needing to be reminded.

- Notice missing information and inconsistencies.

- Ask questions when something doesn't make sense.

- Enjoy improving systems and finding more efficient ways to work.

- Are comfortable working in a small business where processes are still being developed.

- Experience in lead generation, sales support, business development, partnerships, CRM administration or executive/virtual assistance would be helpful.



LOGISTICS:

- Full-time remote position

- Working hours to be agreed, with some overlap with UK working hours

- Regular check-ins with Janna (daily written updates, weekly Zoom call)

- Training, templates and clear research/outreach guidelines will be provided

- You'll work with tools including our CRM, Google Workspace, spreadsheets and other sales/research tools



LENGTH of CONTRACT:

This will be a temporary contract for 1-2 months. If successful, it will be extended.

title: B2B Lead Generation & Business Development Specialist — U.S.
description:
We are seeking an experienced, highly articulate B2B Lead Generation & Business Development Specialist to help expand our Emotional Intelligence training programs into organizations across the United States.



Exceptional spoken and written English is essential for this position. You will be directly communicating with U.S.-based executives, directors, clinical leaders, nonprofit leadership, and other organizational decision-makers. We are looking for someone who communicates naturally, professionally, confidently, and conversationally — not someone who simply reads from a sales script.



Equally important, you must have a strong understanding of Emotional Intelligence and the ability to learn and comprehend a psychology-based program. You need to understand what you are representing well enough to have meaningful conversations, recognize an organization's needs, answer questions intelligently, and communicate our value clearly.



Our flagship program is a 16-week Emotional Intelligence training program designed to support long-term behavioral change through emotional awareness, healthier decision-making, communication, accountability, and practical application.



Our target organizations include nonprofit agencies, behavioral health and treatment organizations, veterans' organizations, corporate wellness programs, government agencies, community-based organizations, and other organizations that could benefit from Emotional Intelligence training.



WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

-Researching and identifying qualified U.S.-based organizations and the correct decision-makers within them.

-Building highly targeted prospect lists rather than simply generating large quantities of unqualified leads.

-Conducting professional outbound outreach through cold calling, cold
, LinkedIn, and other B2B lead-generation strategies.

-Speaking directly with decision-makers and confidently communicating the purpose and value of our program.

-Scheduling qualified presentations and sales conversations.

-Developing appropriate follow-up strategies and consistently moving prospects through the pipeline.

-Maintaining accurate and organized prospect lists, contact information, outreach history, follow-up dates, and results using Google Sheets.

-Using RingCentral for outbound calling and communication.

-Identifying new lead-generation opportunities and suggesting strategies rather than waiting to be told exactly what to do.

-Learning our Emotional Intelligence program, workbook, audience, and organizational value proposition thoroughly.

-Representing our company professionally and helping develop long-term organizational partnerships.



THIS POSITION REQUIRES EXCELLENT COMMUNICATION

Because you will represent our company directly to U.S. organizations, we are specifically looking for someone with:



-Excellent spoken English and strong conversational fluency.

-Excellent written English.

-Clear, professional telephone communication.

-Confidence speaking with executives and organizational leadership.

-Strong listening and comprehension skills.

-The ability to communicate naturally without relying heavily on scripts.

-The ability to understand Emotional Intelligence concepts and explain them in clear, relatable language.



EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are interested in candidates who can demonstrate what they have actually accomplished, not simply list sales responsibilities. Ideal candidates will have:



-Significant experience in B2B lead generation, business development, appointment setting, or outbound sales.

-Proven experience successfully reaching U.S.-based decision-makers.

-Strong cold-calling and cold
 experience.

-Experience identifying and researching the correct organizational contacts.

-Experience successfully booking qualified meetings or presentations.

-Familiarity with RingCentral or comparable business calling platforms.

-Strong experience using Google Sheets or similar systems to manage prospect pipelines and follow-up.

-Demonstrated longevity with previous employers or clients.

-Specific examples of organizations, accounts, partnerships, meetings, or business opportunities they personally helped secure.

-Experience working with nonprofits, behavioral health organizations, treatment centers, healthcare organizations, veterans' organizations, government agencies, education, corporate wellness, or similar sectors is a strong advantage.



THE TYPE OF PERSON WE WANT

We are not looking for someone who needs to be given a list and told exactly what to do every day.

We want a self-starter and proactive problem solver who:



-Takes ownership of their work.

-Notices when a strategy is not working and adjusts.

-Researches solutions independently.

-Communicates problems early instead of waiting for someone else to discover them.

-Suggests new approaches and opportunities.

-Consistently follows up without being reminded.

-Is organized and accountable.

-Understands that successful business development requires persistence, strategy, relationship-building, and good judgment.



TO APPLY

Please include the following in your application:

-A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your B2B sales/lead-generation experience. Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.

-How many years you have worked specifically in B2B lead generation or business development.

-Your longest position with one company or client and how long you worked with them.

-Two or three specific examples of accounts, organizations, partnerships, or qualified opportunities you personally helped secure. Explain what you did to obtain them.

-Your experience with cold calling U.S.-based prospects and decision-makers.

-Your experience using RingCentral or similar calling systems.

-How you have used Google Sheets, CRMs, or other systems to manage prospecting and follow-up.

-In your own words, briefly explain what Emotional Intelligence means and why an organization might invest in Emotional Intelligence training for its employees or clients.

-Describe a time when a lead-generation strategy was not working and what you changed without waiting for your manager to tell you what to do.





Please do not submit a generic or AI-generated response. We are specifically interested in your actual experience, communication ability, understanding, and results.



POSITION DETAILS



Part-time: Approximately 10 hours per week to start, with the opportunity to increase hours based on performance and business needs.  



Compensation: Hourly rate based on experience, with additional sales/performance bonus opportunities.



This position has the potential to grow for the right person. We are looking for someone interested in becoming a reliable part of our business-development efforts rather than simply completing short-term lead-generation tasks.

title: English teacher online
Experienced Bookkeeper
description:
ABOUT ENSIGN PARTNERS

Ensign Partners is an integrated professional services firm that brings legal, tax, financial, insurance, and business advisory services together under one team.

Our goal is not simply to complete individual tasks. We work together to help business owners organize their companies, make better decisions, protect what they have built, and confidently move their businesses forward.

We are building a team of dependable professionals who take ownership, communicate clearly, execute consistently, and care about the people they serve.

=====================================

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Bookkeeper to support our Tax Team and Business Advisory Team.

This is not simply a data-entry position.

You will be responsible for maintaining accurate client books, identifying and resolving discrepancies, gathering missing information, and helping ensure our tax professionals and business advisors have reliable financial information when they need it.

You will work with multiple businesses and collaborate closely with accountants, tax professionals, business advisors, project managers, and clients.

The right person will take ownership of their assigned clients, proactively follow up on unresolved items, and make sure work is completed accurately and on time.

=====================================

WHAT YOU WILL DO:



CLIENT BOOKKEEPING

*Maintain accurate books for multiple business clients

*Record, categorize, and review financial transactions

*Reconcile bank, credit card, loan, and other balance sheet accounts

*Review accounts for duplicate, missing, or incorrectly categorized transactions

*Maintain accurate accounts receivable and accounts payable records

*Review balance sheets and profit-and-loss statements for accuracy

*Investigate discrepancies and make appropriate corrections

*Maintain supporting documentation and organized client records

*Complete monthly bookkeeping and close-out procedures

*Prepare financial reports for internal review and client meetings



TAX/CFO TEAM SUPPORT

*Prepare clean and organized bookkeeping files for tax preparation

*Identify missing information or unresolved transactions before tax work begins

*Assist with year-end bookkeeping adjustments

*Provide reports and supporting documentation requested by the Tax Team

*Communicate bookkeeping issues that could affect tax planning or tax preparation

*Help ensure client financial information is complete, accurate, and delivered on schedule

*Assist with 1099 preparation and related year-end reporting

*Support other tax-related accounting projects as assigned



BUSINESS TACTICAL TEAM SUPPORT

Help business advisors understand the financial condition of client companies

*Prepare accurate reports for tactical planning and client meetings

*Identify unusual transactions, financial trends, and potential concerns

*Track outstanding client information and follow up until it is received

*Coordinate with team members to keep client projects moving

*Document bookkeeping procedures and client-specific requirements

*Maintain accurate notes, task updates, and deadlines in our systems

*Help improve internal bookkeeping processes, templates, and workflows

*Help ensure important financial details do not fall through the cracks



CLIENT COMMUNICATION

*Communicate professionally with clients through
 and virtual meetings

*Request statements, receipts, explanations, and other missing information

*Explain bookkeeping questions in a clear and respectful manner

*Follow up consistently without waiting for someone else to remind you

*Keep clients and internal team members informed of progress, delays, and unresolved issues

*Build trust by being responsive, accurate, and dependable

=====================================

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

*You will be successful in this role when:

*Client books are consistently accurate and current

*Bank and credit card accounts are fully reconciled

*Balance sheet accounts are reviewed and supported

*Bookkeeping issues are identified before they become larger problems

*Missing information is followed up on and resolved

*Tax professionals receive clean and organized financial records

*Financial reports are reliable and ready when needed

*Client deadlines are tracked and completed on time

*Team members always know the status of your work

*You take ownership of problems instead of passing them to someone else

*Clients and coworkers know they can depend on you

*You help improve the systems and processes around you

=====================================

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

*At least 3 years of professional bookkeeping experience

*Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple companies or clients

*Strong experience using QuickBooks Online

*Strong understanding of bookkeeping and accounting fundamentals

*Experience reconciling bank, credit card, loan, payroll, and balance sheet accounts

*Ability to read and understand balance sheets and profit-and-loss statements

*Strong Microsoft Excel Skills

*Excellent attention to detail

*Strong written and spoken English

*Professional client communication skills

*Ability to organize and manage multiple deadlines

*Ability to investigate discrepancies and solve problems independently

*Reliable internet connection and professional remote-work environment

*Ability to protect confidential client and financial information

=====================================



OUR CORE VALUES:



ENJOY THE JOURNEY

We work hard, maintain perspective, support one another, and bring a positive attitude to the work we do.

MOVE THE CHEESE

We adapt when circumstances change. We do not remain stuck in old processes simply because they are familiar.

BE YOUR BEST

We prepare, improve, accept feedback, and consistently work to become better professionals and teammates.

AIM TO WIN

We approach our work with purpose. We set meaningful goals, solve problems, and focus on producing strong results.

RAISE THE BAR

We do not settle for average work. We look for ways to improve our quality, service, systems, and execution.

KEEP YOUR WORD

We do what we say we will do. When circumstances change, we communicate early and take responsibility.

STRONGER AS ONE

We share information, help our teammates, and make decisions based on what is best for the client and the entire company.

=====================================

WHY JOIN ENSIGN PARTNERS?



-> Full-time, long-term opportunity.



-> Work with a growing U.S.-based professional services company.



-> Be part of a collaborative team.



-> Work directly with experienced business, legal, insurance, financial, and tax professionals.



-> Opportunity to grow as Ensign Partners grows.



-> Make a meaningful contribution to our clients and our team.



========================================



HOW TO APPLY



Please follow these instructions carefully.



Do NOT
 us directly. Applicants who
 outside this job posting will be disqualified.

Use this subject line:



Experienced Bookkeeper at Ensign Partners



Include the following:



Your updated resume

*A brief introduction explaining why you are interested in this position

*A description of your QuickBooks Online experience

*The number of business clients or company files you have managed at one time

*An example of a bookkeeping discrepancy you identified and how you resolved it

*Your English proficiency level.

*An introductory video is recommended.  



Pay depends on experience.



Work hours are full-time U.S. Arizona business hours.

title: Operations Manager
description:
We're a digital media company running a portfolio of media channels. A remote team, content pipelines, and ongoing correspondence with US agencies that supply the source material our content is built on. The content is high-production, the operation is scaling fast, and the team is growing to 30+ VAs over the next few months.

We're looking for an operations right-hand to help run it. This is not a task-VA role. You'll be the layer between the founder and the team, the person things route through, the person who makes the calls that don't need to reach the founder's desk.

This is a challenge role. If you want a comfortable job, don’t apply.



If you're an experienced operations manager or senior executive VA who has actually managed teams and wants a real ownership seat in a scaling company, this is the right fit.



What the job is:

The core of the role, and most of your week, is running the team of VAs who handle our ongoing communication with US agencies. You keep them on track, you're their first point of contact, and you make sure the correspondence keeps moving without the founder in the loop.

- Team coordination: leading the VAs, keeping them on track, being their point of contact, escalating to the founder only what genuinely needs it

title: Part-Time PPC Manager — High-Ticket Ecommerce, Google + Meta (UK Brand, 15 hrs/week)
description:
We're Kiln Crafts, a UK company that designs and makes pottery equipment — wheels, kilns, clay rollers, extruders, pugmills. We sell direct to people setting up at home: beginners in a spare room, a garage, a shed.



This is high-ticket. Our wheels are £1,499–£1,699. Our pugmill is £3,999. People research for weeks before they buy, and most of them have never owned a wheel before and are quite nervous about spending that much. Everything we do is built around making that feel easy rather than pressuring anyone.



We're also building a brand, not just running performance campaigns. We care about what people think of us before they're ready to buy.



We're a small team. You'd work directly with Matt, the founder. No layers, no account managers, no politics.



The role



We spend around £7,500 a month across Google Ads and Meta. The accounts are already built and running — campaigns are structured, tracking is in place, conversions are firing. We're not asking you to start from scratch or fix a mess.



What we need is someone to own the day-to-day: watch the numbers, cut what's wasting money, scale what's working, and keep the product feed clean. Alongside that, we'll be running brand campaigns that won't be judged on last-click ROAS — you'd help us run and measure those properly.



Roughly 15 hours a week. We've set it there because that's honestly what the work needs right now. If you get in and find the account justifies more — or if we grow and it does — we're happy to increase your hours and your pay to match. We'd rather start realistic and grow it than promise you a full week and quietly shrink it.



This is not low-ticket ecommerce, and we're being upfront about that



If your experience is mostly dropshipping or £20–50 products, this will be frustrating for both of us. Here, conversion volume is low, smart bidding is under-fed, a single sale is worth more than a hundred cheap ones, and discount-and-urgency tactics actively damage trust with a nervous buyer. We need someone who's worked in that world and understands why it's different.



What you'd own



Google Ads — Search, Performance Max and Shopping. Weekly search-term mining, negative keyword lists, budget pacing, bid strategy adjustments, new ad copy variants.

Meta Ads — campaign and ad set management, audience testing, creative rotation, pausing fatigued ads, scaling the winners.

Brand campaigns — running upper-funnel activity and measuring it honestly, on the right metrics rather than on last-click ROAS.

Google Merchant Centre — feed health, product disapprovals, attribute fixes. Keeping Shopping actually eligible to serve.

Reporting — one short weekly report. Spend, CPA, ROAS, what changed, what you'd do next. Written in plain English, not a dashboard screenshot.



What you would NOT own



Setting or changing overall budgets — Matt does that

Designing creative (you'd flag what's needed, we produce it)

Website,
, SEO, or customer service

Strategy and pricing decisions



Required



3+ years running live Google Ads and Meta accounts — hands in the account, not reading reports someone else built

Real high-ticket experience. You've run paid media for products or services at £500+ per sale, with a considered purchase cycle. Tell us which brands and what the price points were.

Brand campaign experience. You've run upper-funnel or brand activity and can explain how you measured whether it worked without falling back on last-click ROAS.

Managed at least £5,000/month in spend and can tell us specifically what you did with it

Comfortable in Google Merchant Centre and product feeds for an ecommerce store

Can look at a search terms report and immediately see the waste

Clear written English — you can explain a decision without hiding behind jargon

Work independently. We brief weekly, not hourly.



Nice to have



Shopify ecommerce experience

UK or European market experience

Premium, craft, design or homeware brands specifically

Any interest in pottery, ceramics or making things (genuinely — it shows in the work)



Portfolio — please include this



We want to see actual work, not a list of skills. Include whatever you can share:



Named companies or brands you've run paid media for, with the price point of what they sold and roughly how long you were there

Screenshots of real account performance you were responsible for — blur the client name if you're under NDA, but show us the numbers and tell us what you changed

A brand campaign you ran — what the objective was, what you did, and how you knew whether it worked

Links to anything public: case studies, ads still running, a LinkedIn profile



If you're under NDA and can't name clients, say so and describe the business type and price point instead. We'd much rather have an honest "premium furniture brand, £800–2,000 AOV, can't name them" than a vague claim we can't check.



What we offer



$700 USD/month, paid on time, every month

₱2,000/month rice allowance on top

13th month bonus

Salary review at 12 months

Room to grow. If the account needs more of your time, we'll add hours and pay for them

Long-term role. We want someone who's still here in three years, not a three-month contractor

Direct access to the founder. Your recommendations get read and acted on



Hours



15 hours a week to start, roughly 3 hours a day Monday to Friday. We'd like 2 of those hours to overlap with UK working hours (around 4–7pm Philippine time) so we can talk when we need to. The rest is yours to schedule.



If the role grows into more hours we'll discuss it openly and pay accordingly — but we won't quietly expand the job without changing the money.



How to apply



Please start your application with the word KILN so we know you've read this properly.



Then answer these five questions and include your portfolio. Short answers are fine — we'd rather have five honest paragraphs than a long CV.



Which companies have you run paid media for, what did they sell, and at what price point? Name them if you can.

What's the highest-value single product or service you've run ads for, and what was the typical time between someone first seeing an ad and buying?

Our wheels are £1,499 and people take weeks to d
. We get about 33 purchases a month across £5,300 of Meta spend, plus 269 leads at £20 each. What would you do differently here compared with a £40 product, and why?

Describe a brand campaign you've run. What was the goal, and how did you know whether it worked?

Which hours would you work, in Philippine time — and how many hours a week are you realistically available for if the role grows?



Applications that don't start with KILN, or that skip questions 3 and 4, won't be read.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
We're looking for a **Bookkeeper** with deep QuickBooks expertise to own the books for a fast-moving, fully remote software holding company operating across multiple products and revenue streams. You will manage day-to-day bookkeeping, reconciliations, reporting, and financial record-keeping with minimal oversight and maximum accuracy.



This is a high-ownership, execution-driven role. You will not be given detailed instructions on how to manage the books — you are expected to know QuickBooks inside and out, set up and maintain clean financial records independently, and surface the right information to leadership without being asked. If you are a strong bookkeeper who lives in QuickBooks, takes full ownership of financial accuracy, and can operate reliably in a fully async remote environment, this role is a strong fit.



## Why You'll Want to Join



- You will be paid in **USD** (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)

- **Paid Time Off** in accordance with company policy

- Observance of **Holidays** per company guidelines

- **100% remote setup** so you can work wherever you're most productive

- Work inside a lean, profitable software holding company with multiple active revenue streams

- High-ownership bookkeeping role with direct access to leadership and real impact on financial visibility



## What You'll Work On



**Day-to-Day Bookkeeping**



- Manage all day-to-day bookkeeping activity including recording transactions, categorizing expenses, and maintaining accurate financial records

- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and payment processor accounts on a regular basis

- Ensure the chart of accounts is organized, consistent, and accurate across all entities and revenue streams

- Process accounts payable and accounts receivable and keep all records current



**QuickBooks Management**



- Own and maintain the QuickBooks environment end to end including setup, configuration, and ongoing maintenance

- Build and manage workflows within QuickBooks that keep financial operations clean and efficient

- Troubleshoot discrepancies, reconciliation issues, and data inconsistencies independently

- Leverage QuickBooks features fully to automate and streamline recurring bookkeeping tasks



**Reporting and Financial Visibility**



- Generate regular financial reports including profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and cash flow summaries

- Maintain organized financial records that are audit-ready at all times

- Support month-end and year-end close processes accurately and on time



**Coordination and Compliance Support**



- Coordinate with external accountants or tax advisors as needed to support filings and compliance requirements

- Maintain clean documentation of all financial activity for internal and external reference

- Support ad hoc financial requests from leadership with speed and accuracy



## What You Bring



- Deep, hands-on QuickBooks proficiency — you know the platform thoroughly and can set it up, manage it, and troubleshoot it independently

- Proven bookkeeping experience managing full-cycle books for a business with multiple revenue streams

- Strong reconciliation skills with a zero-tolerance approach to inaccuracies

- Ability to work fully independently in a remote environment without requiring close supervision

- Highly organized with strong attention to detail and consistent follow-through

If you are a QuickBooks expert who takes full ownership of financial accuracy and wants to manage the books for a growing portfolio of software products, this role gives you the autonomy and the direct impact to do your best work.

You will take ownership of Meta paid advertising and our organic social activity, while working alongside our existing Marketing Manager who remains responsible for the WordPress website, GenieAI / GoHighLevel CRM, workflows and AI systems.



This role is about commercial results. Likes, followers and reach are useful diagnostics, but they are not the objective. We want somebody who can show us how they have used Meta to generate qualified enquiries and can explain the spend, cost per lead, lead quality, testing process and what they personally changed to improve results.



The role

• Part-time remote consultant based in the Philippines.

• Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

• 8 hours per day during UK working hours (24 hours per week).

• Long-term opportunity for the right person.

• Hourly rate to be agreed according to proven Meta experience and results.



What you will own

•
 and Instagram paid advertising strategy and day-to-day campaign management.

• Campaign setup, targeting, retargeting, creative testing, optimisation and reporting.

• Ad creative concepts, copy, hooks, static designs and short-form video/Reels.

• Organic content for
, Instagram, Google Business Profile and LinkedIn.

• Weekly reporting focused on qualified leads and return on investment.

• Working with our Marketing Manager so landing pages, tracking and CRM lead feedback support the campaigns.



You must be able to demonstrate

• Strong hands-on experience inside Meta Ads Manager.

• Real lead-generation campaigns that you personally managed.

• Actual examples showing budget, leads, cost per lead and what happened after optimisation.

• An understanding of high-ticket Business-to-Consumer marketing where trust is important and customers do not buy instantly.

• Excellent English, reliability and clear communication during UK working hours.

• A professional home working setup with reliable internet and power.



Important

Please do not apply if your experience is mainly scheduling posts, graphic design or general VA work. Creative skills are useful, but we are specifically recruiting somebody who is highly competent at Meta paid advertising and understands profitable lead generation.



How to apply

In your first message, please answer ALL five questions below. Applications that do not answer them may not be progressed.

1. What is the strongest Meta lead-generation campaign you have personally managed? Give the product/service, total or monthly spend, number of leads, cost per lead and any information you have on lead quality or sales.

2. Imagine you are advertising a £25,000-£100,000 home-improvement project to homeowners in the South of England. How would your campaign approach differ from eCommerce or low-ticket advertising?

3. When Meta is generating cheap leads but the sales team says the leads are poor quality, what are the first five things you investigate or change?

4. Show us one advert/creative or campaign you are most proud of and explain exactly what YOU did rather than what the wider team did.

5. Why are you looking for a long-term part-time role, and can you commit reliably to Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday during UK working hours?

Final instruction

At the end of your application, write the words 'QUALIFIED LEADS' and tell us, in one sentence, which business or marketing person you most admire and why.

title: Relationship & Business Development Executive
description:
Be the Face of Artfello. Build New Relationships. Create Bigger Growth.



Artfello is growing rapidly and internationally, and we’re looking for someone who can represent us in sales meetings, build strong relationships and turn conversations into opportunities.



For 13 years, we have been in business, developing relationships and creating opportunities across international markets. Today, our growth is creating more conversations, more meetings and more opportunities than ever before.



We’re looking for someone who knows what to do with that growth.



The Role



As a Relationship & Business Development Executive Assistant, you will be one of the faces of Artfello outward.



A major part of your role will be taking virtual sales meetings with potential clients, partners and professionals around the world.



These are not simply calls you need to get through.



You’ll be expected to make a strong first impression, create a natural connection, understand who you’re speaking with, identify what matters to them and recognize where there is a genuine opportunity to work together.



You should be charming, confident, professional and naturally good with people.



But being personable is only the beginning.



You need to know how to turn a good conversation into a business opportunity.



You’ll learn how to present Artfello, ask the right questions, read between the lines, handle objections, follow up and ultimately close opportunities.



You may also support our wider business development activities through outreach,
 campaigns, follow-ups and relationship management.



More Responsibility. More Opportunity.



We are growing, and we want people who can grow with us.



Prove that you can handle clients, relationships and business opportunities, and you can take on more responsibility.



Future opportunities can include:



Senior Business Development → Team Leader → Operations → Regional Management



For those who prove themselves, there may also be opportunities to work from our physical offices in Amsterdam.



Who Qualifies?



We’re not looking for someone who simply wants to fill a position.



We’re looking for someone who wants more from life.



Someone who knows how to prioritize.



Someone who can read between the lines.



Someone who takes initiative instead of waiting to be told what to do.



Someone who can show — not just tell — us that they have ambition, drive and potential.



No experience? That's fine.



We’ll give you the training, structure and guidance to get started.



But we cannot give you ambition.



We cannot teach you to care about the result.



And we cannot make you want more.



That part has to come from you.



What You Get:

Work remotely from anywhere

Flexible schedule

Virtual meetings with people around the world

Training and ongoing guidance

Base salary and performance-based commissions

Real responsibility from the beginning

Clear opportunities for advancement

Potential opportunities to work from Amsterdam

The opportunity to grow alongside an international company



Apply by sending your CV and a short personal letter telling us a little about yourself and why you think you would fit at Artfello.



Send directly to:





Director & Co-Founder



Learn More About Us

title: Full-time Shopify Developer
description:
We're a fast-growing DTC supplement brand running on Shopify. We ship new offers and landing pages constantly and need a developer who can turn a design reference into a live, fast, converting page without hand-holding.



The role:



Your first project: build a high-converting product landing page for our flagship offer, matched closely to the structure and feel of 
 (long-form supplement LP, sticky add-to-cart, bundle selector, review and comparison sections, trust badges, FAQ). Take that as the benchmark for layout, section flow, and polish. Copy, branding, imagery, and colours will be ours.



Ongoing work after that includes new LPs, A/B test variants, theme and section development, speed optimisation, app integrations, and general store maintenance.



What you'll do:



- Build custom Shopify sections and landing pages in Liquid, HTML, CSS, JS

- Build reusable, merchant-editable sections so our team can update content without a dev

- Integrate upsell, subscription, and review apps (ReCharge, Rebuy, 
, Klaviyo, etc.)

- Hit 90+ mobile PageSpeed and keep CLS low, since most of our traffic is paid mobile

- Set up and QA A/B tests, plus tracking (GA4, Meta Pixel, GTM)

- Fix bugs and handle theme updates



Requirements:



- 2+ years of hands-on Shopify development (Shopify 2.0 architecture, Liquid, metafields, metaobjects)

- Strong front-end: HTML, CSS, vanilla JS. Bonus for React and Node

- Proven pixel-accurate work from a design or reference site

- Mobile-first, conversion-focused mindset. You understand this is a paid-traffic asset, not a portfolio piece

- Git, and comfortable working in ClickUp or similar

- Good written English and fast communication



Nice to have:



- Experience with supplement or health brands

- Shopify Plus, Shopify Functions, checkout extensibility

- Figma to Shopify workflow

- Basic design ability so you can fill layout gaps yourself



How to apply



Do not send a generic application. It will be ignored. Send:



1. 3 Shopify landing pages you personally built, with live links

2. A short note on what you'd change about 
's page to improve conversion

3. Your monthly rate and weekly availability

4. Start your reply with the word "CAPSULE" so I know you read this



Fast hiring process. 



One thing worth flagging: use their page as a structural and UX reference, but have your dev rebuild it rather than copying their code, images, or copywriting. Cloned assets are what gets a store hit with a takedown.

Logo

Brand colors

Images (where provided)

Contact information

Business details

-Experienced with WordPress and Elementor Pro.

-Very detail-oriented and capable of accurately recreating a website.

-Strong in frontend implementation (desktop and mobile responsive).

-Reliable and able to meet a 48-hour deadline.

-Able to follow instructions precisely with minimal revisions.



Attention to detail is the most important quality for this job. We expect the first submission to be as close to final as possible.



Compensation



-Fixed Price: $100 USD

-Project Type: One-time gig

-Deadline: 48 hours after the contract begins.

title: Operations & Delivery Manager (Client Systems)
description:
About Us

Bolder Digital is an Australian-based recruitment agency committed to connecting top Filipino talent with leading businesses globally. We are looking for an individual to join our team and work remotely from the Philippines as we are based in Australia (Remote, based in the Philippines, working on Australian Eastern Time Zone 8/9 AM – 5 PM).



Job Type

Full-Time – Long term/Gig



Start Date:

ASAP



Compensation:

Negotiable — based on proven expertise



1. Purpose of the Role

The Operations & Delivery Manager is responsible for turning The Event Engineer methodology into working systems inside client accounts, and for keeping those systems running through every event cycle.



This role owns the build, the delivery and the client relationship at an operational level. It is the bridge between what is sold on a strategy call and what actually exists inside GoHighLevel on event day. When a client's funnel, automation, portal or event works, this role built it. When it breaks, this role fixes it.



The role is accountable for client outcomes at the delivery layer: events that launch on time, funnels that convert, automations that fire correctly, and clients who feel supported without the Founder having to intervene.





2. Scope

Client portfolio: Full operational responsibility for all active equity and retained client accounts, plus incoming Event Engineer beta clients. Typical portfolio size is three to six concurrent accounts, each running its own event cycle.



Event volume: Multiple live client events per quarter, each on a recurring turnover cycle of roughly four to six weeks, plus The Event Engineer's own events.



Systems: GoHighLevel (all client sub-accounts and the master account), ClickUp, the Event Engineer Studio platform, Canva, Zoom,
 Groups, Skool, Circle, Stripe payment configuration within GHL, Replit, and Loom.





3. Key Responsibility Areas

3.1 Client Delivery Management

Own the day to day operational relationship with each assigned client.



Act as the primary operational point of contact for clients in their dedicated channels, responding to build requests, technical questions and delivery issues.

Translate client requests into scoped, prioritised tasks, and push back or escalate where a request falls outside agreed scope.

Maintain a prioritised task list per client and keep the client visible on status, blockers and timelines.

Run proactive check-ins on an agreed cadence: more frequently in the lead up to an event, weekly at baseline.

Send pre-event support messages, event turnover checklists and event reflection forms, and chase the inputs needed to close each cycle.

Record walkthrough videos and short training clips so clients can self-serve on recurring tasks.

Attend client calls where technical input is required, and convert call outcomes into actioned tasks.

Flag client risk early: unmet expectations, scope creep, delivery slippage, or a client going quiet.

3.2 GoHighLevel Build & Automation

Design, build, test and maintain the full technical stack inside client sub-accounts.



Build and maintain workflows, triggers, conditions, tags, dynamic tags and custom values.

Build and maintain
 and SMS sequences across every funnel phase: registration, launch, nurture, stick, live day, replay, VIP upsell, retargeting, sales and onboarding.

Build funnel pages: landing, registration, thank you, VIP upsell, order, sales, sign in, event portal, replay, waitlist and feedback pages, including mobile views.

Configure products, pricing, payment plans, coupons, order bumps and refund processes.

Configure calendars, booking flows, forms, surveys and pre-session intake.

Manage domains, sub-domains,
 deliverability, sender reputation, phone number provisioning and A2P registration.

Build and maintain pipelines, opportunity stages and follow-up automations.

Set up communities and course delivery inside GHL, and build integrations to external platforms such as Skool and Circle where required.

Own snapshot management: creation, versioning, cleanup and deployment across client accounts.

Test everything end to end before it goes live. No sequence, page or automation goes to a client without a full test pass.

3.3 Event Delivery Lifecycle

Run the full operational cycle for every client event, from set up through to turnover.



Pre-event set up



Branding board, domain,
, phone integration and account configuration.

Build or update the event funnel, portal, community group and all supporting assets.

Configure the event calendar invite builder, timezone handling and countdown timers.

Schedule the pre-event social,
 and SMS sequences.



Live event



Monitor systems throughout the event and resolve faults in real time.

Confirm Zoom links, sign in flows, attendance tracking and portal access are live across all comms before day one.

Update replay pages, post daily group content and manage attendance workflows day by day.



Post-event turnover



Run the standard turnover checklist against every client account: dates in
 and SMS copy, automation date triggers, tag names, workflow triggers and conditions, product prices, money-off codes,
 and SMS links, pipelines, registration and sign in pages, waitlist updates.

Manage refunds, group closure, member removal and the reset of social assets.

Set up the next event cycle and confirm the new dates are live everywhere.

Progressively automate steps of the turnover so the cycle gets faster each time.

3.4 Gamification & Interactive Builds

Design and build instant-feedback gamification systems layered on top of GHL event portals, including chains, hearts, badges, progress trackers and unlockable rewards.

Produce the supporting graphics, unlock logic, webhooks and external services required.

Build the client-facing explanation assets: how-to-play videos, onboarding
s and walkthrough recordings.

Test gamification against real audience conditions and resolve display or trigger failures.

3.5 Event Engineer Product & Systems Support

Work alongside the development team on the Event Engineer Studio platform: custom fields, login and access automation, onboarding webhooks, snapshot logic and sub-account provisioning.

Participate in structured platform testing cycles and report defects with clear reproduction steps.

Maintain the master Event Engineer GHL account: whitelabelling, branding consistency, disclaimers, workflow hygiene and removal of unused sub-accounts.

Build internal tools that reduce manual delivery load, including reporting and analysis applications.

Confirm build logic with developers where the platform and the delivery methodology intersect.

3.6 Systems Integrity, Documentation & SOPs

Run a regular systems health check across GoHighLevel and ClickUp, and report anything breaking or at risk of breaking.

Maintain and improve delivery SOPs: event turnover, Zoom configuration, testing checklists, backend event running, gamification builds and client change requests.

Document every build so another tea
mber can pick it up. Nothing critical sits only in one person's head.

Maintain credential and access hygiene across all platforms, including rotation when a tea
mber or contractor exits.

Build and maintain the client change-request process so scope is captured, priced and tracked.

3.7 Delivery Coordination

Maintain the ClickUp structure for delivery: lists, statuses, deadlines and priorities across all client accounts.

Add realistic duration estimates to build tasks and hold the delivery timeline.

Coordinate contractors and developers assigned to delivery work, including briefing, handover and quality review of their output.

Schedule client calls and delivery meetings, and manage the meeting cadence per client.

Report weekly on delivery status, blockers and upcoming event dates.





4. Success Measures

Performance in this role is assessed against:



Measure

Target

On-time event delivery

100% of client events launch on their agreed date with all funnels, automations and portals live and tested

Live event fault rate

Zero critical faults during a live event. Any fault resolved within the session it occurs in

Event turnover completion

Full turnover checklist closed within five business days of an event ending

Client responsiveness

Client operational requests acknowledged same business day, with a clear timeline given

Build quality

No client-facing build goes live without a documented end to end test pass

Documentation coverage

Every recurring delivery process has a current SOP that another tea
mber can execute

Founder escalation rate

Declining volume of delivery issues requiring Founder intervention

Continuity

A named, briefed backup exists for every client account and every critical system







5. Skills & Experience Required

Essential



Advanced, hands-on GoHighLevel expertise across workflows, funnels, custom values, snapshots, products, calendars, communities and deliverability. This is the single most important technical requirement.

Demonstrated experience building and running online event funnels end to end.

Strong automation logic: able to reason about triggers, conditions, tags, timing and re-entry, and to debug why something did not fire.

Comfortable with HTML, CSS and JavaScript at the level needed for custom page elements and embedded widgets.

Experience with webhooks, APIs and connecting third-party services.

Confident client-facing written communication. Able to explain a technical problem to a non-technical business owner without jargon or defensiveness.

Project management discipline: able to hold multiple client accounts, multiple event cycles and competing deadlines at once without dropping items.

High standard of testing and quality assurance. Checks work before it ships.



Desirable



Experience with Zapier, Make or n8n.

Experience with Skool, Circle, Zoom configuration and
 Group management at scale.

Experience building lightweight internal tools or apps.

Canva and basic design capability for event assets.

Prior exposure to equity or revenue-share client models where delivery quality directly drives the fee.





6. Attributes

Ownership. Takes a problem to resolution rather than reporting it and waiting.

Integrity. Says what is actually true about status and timelines, including when something has slipped.

Calm under event pressure. Live events do not allow for panic. Faults get diagnosed and fixed.

Systems thinking. Solves the class of problem, not just the instance. Automates repeated work.

Boundaried. Supports clients generously without letting client urgency override agreed priorities and scope.

Documents by default. Builds so that someone else could take over tomorrow.





7. Working Arrangements

Full time, remote, with core overlap to Melbourne business hours.

Availability outside standard hours during live client event windows, with time back in lieu. Event weeks are known and blocked in advance.

Planned leave to be flagged at least two weeks ahead where possible, with handover notes and a named cover for each active client.

Weekly one to one with the Founder, plus participation in team check-ins.





8. Continuity Requirement

Because this role holds the technical and operational knowledge for every client account, continuity is a formal part of the job, not an optional extra. The incumbent is required to:



Maintain current written SOPs for all recurring delivery processes.

Record walkthrough videos for any build that is non-obvious.

Keep a live handover document per client covering status, credentials location, open items and known quirks.

Brief a nominated backup before any planned absence.



How to Apply



Submit the following:

- Resume

- Short cover letter explaining how you are fit to work in this role mentioning the experience you have and how it would help you complete this role at a high level.

- A portfolio with any examples

- Use the application code WOWZA so we know you’ve read the full role description.



IMPORTANT: This is an expert-only position. You will be skills-tested.

If you’re not proven, not fast, or not world-class — this isn’t for you.

title: Oil & Gas Equipment Procurement & Asset Management SME
description:
Role Overview:

We are seeking a Subject Matter Expert in Oil & Gas Procurement to serve as our primary technical and commercial authority on industrial equipment, critical spares, and MRO materials. In this role, you will dictate sourcing strategy, evaluate technical compatibilities, and advise engineering and operations on lifecycle asset management to control costs and eliminate downtime risk.



Core Responsibilities:



Technical & Commercial Authority: Serve as the definitive expert on the procurement of pumps, valves, rotating equipment, instrumentation, and piping. Validate technical specifications, BOMs, and engineering datasheets prior to sourcing.



Strategic Sourcing: Lead complex, end-to-end RFx processes. Compare technical quotations, negotiate high-stakes commercial terms, and manage vendor performance against warranties and SLAs.



Lifecycle & Risk Advisory: Guide critical "repair-versus-replace" decisions. Formulate risk-mitigation strategies for critical-spares inventory, turnaround/shutdown planning, and expediting long-lead items.



Problem Resolution & Systems: Act as the ultimate escalation point for identifying alternative components for obsolete parts. Ensure impeccable data integrity and workflow logic within ERP/CMMS platforms (SAP, Oracle, Maximo).



Qualifications & Expertise:



Deep Domain Knowledge: 5+ years of specialized procurement experience in oil & gas, petrochemicals, or heavy industrial environments. (Note: Elevated from 3+ to reflect SME expectations).



Technical Fluency: Advanced ability to interpret complex engineering requirements, read technical documentation, and cross-reference equipment models.



Systems Proficiency: Power-user experience with major ERP/CMMS systems for asset and inventory management.



Strategic Communication: Proven ability to bridge the gap between field operations, technical engineering, and external vendors.

title: Video Editor – Turn Scripts into Sales Machines
description:
We're looking for a full-time Video Editor to create high-converting videos and animation-style content for our e-commerce funnels.



This role is for someone who's not just an editor, but a performance-minded storyteller, able to turn scripts into sales assets using the right mix of visuals, pacing, and emotional logic.



Your mission:

Deliver high-quality video content weekly by sourcing the right clips, following scripts, and bringing ideas to life through animation, transitions, and smart editing.



What you'll be doing:



- Edit performance-driven videos based on provided scripts

- Source visual clips from stock platforms, YouTube, UGC, TikTok, etc.

- Use VEO3 AI tool to generate supplemental content when needed

- Create dynamic animations, text callouts, and transitions to improve engagement

- Work with copywriters and funnel strategists to match message and visuals

- Send daily EOD updates with your progress

- Collaborate in a fast-paced team, take feedback, iterate, improve



Requirements:



- Proven experience editing performance-driven or direct response videos

- Ability to source visuals efficiently (stock, UGC, TikTok, etc.)

- Strong sense of direct response structure (Hook ? Problem ? Agitation ? Solution ? CTA)

- Familiarity with tools like VEO3 is a plus, but not a replacement for clip sourcing

- Full-time availability; we are not hiring part-time or agency editors

- Strong communication skills and daily accountability

- Deadline-driven, proactive, and detail-oriented



Do not apply if:



- You only edit short, flashy TikToks with no sales structure

- You expect all assets to be handed to you. You must source content

- You can't commit to full-time work or daily check-ins



Application Questions:



1. Can you share 2–3 links to sales-driven videos you've edited? (Preferably for health, wellness, or beauty products.)

2. What's your process for finding visual content (clips, b-roll, UGC) to match a script? Briefly describe the tools or sources you typically use.

3. Are you available full-time (5 days/week) and able to send daily EOD updates? Yes / No

5. What's the most profitable video you've ever edited or helped produce? How much net profit or revenue did it help generate in 90 days? What was your specific contribution to that video? Paste hard evidence (funnel backend, performance dashboards, screenshots, or live links).



Thank you for your application!

title: B2B Cold Caller – US Property Management SaaS
description:
BondKnows is a U.S.-based software startup helping property managers improve how residents report maintenance issues. Residents scan a QR code, answer a few questions and upload photos, giving the property manager a much more complete maintenance request.



We are looking for an excellent outbound cold caller / appointment setter based in the Philippines.



This role is primarily PHONE CALLING. It is not a general VA position.



Your job will be to call U.S. property-management companies, reach property managers / owners / maintenance leaders, ask a few short discovery questions, explain BondKnows clearly, and schedule qualified 15-minute conversations with our founder.



Responsibilities:



* Make outbound B2B cold calls during U.S. business hours

* Call from a lead list we provide

* Navigate receptionists and gatekeepers

* Reach property managers and decision-makers

* Have natural conversations rather than simply reading a script

* Ask questions about how the company currently receives and handles resident maintenance requests

* Schedule qualified meetings

* Record every call outcome and useful notes

* Follow up with interested prospects when appropriate

* Share common objections and insights so we can continuously improve the pitch



We care much more about QUALITY + RESULTS than simply logging hours.



Ideal candidate:



* Excellent spoken English

* Very comfortable speaking with U.S. business prospects

* Prior B2B cold-calling or appointment-setting experience

* Strong phone presence

* Can confidently get past gatekeepers

* Good listener who can respond naturally to objections

* Reliable internet, headset and quiet work environment

* Organized and accurate with call notes

* Coachable

* Experience selling SaaS, real estate, property management, home services or other B2B products is a plus



Schedule

Initially approximately 15–20 hours per week, Monday–Friday, during U.S. business hours. Strong performers can receive substantially more hours.



Compensation

Hourly base pay plus performance bonuses for qualified meetings that actually occur and successful customer pilots.



HOW TO APPLY — PLEASE FOLLOW ALL INSTRUCTIONS



Start your application with the words BLUE HOUSE.



Please include:



1. A link to a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your cold-calling experience.

2. What company/product you most recently cold-called for.

3. Who you were calling.

4. Approximately how many outbound calls you personally made per working day.

5. Approximately how many appointments you booked in an average week.

6. How many hours per week you are available.

7. Your expected hourly rate.



Finally, answer this:



You call a property-management company and the property manager says: “We already use AppFolio for maintenance.” What would you say next?



Applications without the requested information will not be considered.



There will be a short interview followed by a paid calling trial for finalists.

---



Working in Complex Advertising Environments



Lucyd specializes in helping brands grow in industries where advertising is rarely straightforward.



Many of our clients operate in highly regulated or policy-constrained categories, including hemp-derived cannabinoids, cannabis-adjacent products, telehealth services, GLP-1s, peptides, supplements, and functional wellness products.



Success in these industries requires more than platform expertise. It requires curiosity, adaptability, strategic thinking, and a willingness to challenge conventional approaches while operating within evolving platform policies.



We are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex advertising challenges and can consistently find innovative ways to help clients scale responsibly.



---



What You’ll Own

- Build, launch, manage, and optimize Meta advertising campaigns across a portfolio of DTC ecommerce clients.

- Execute testing plans across audiences, creatives, placements, budgets, and campaign structures.

- Monitor campaign performance daily and make data-driven optimization decisions that improve efficiency and profitability.

- Manage campaign budgets and pacing while maintaining alignment with client performance goals.

- Troubleshoot campaign delivery issues, tracking discrepancies, and platform-related challenges.



Performance Analysis



- Analyze campaign performance using Meta Ads Manager and supporting analytics platforms.

- Identify trends across creative, messaging, audiences, offers, and funnel performance.

- Understand *why* creative is succeeding or underperforming, using performance data to generate actionable insights.

- Monitor key performance metrics including MER, aMER, CAC, bCAC, CPA, CPM, and other leading indicators.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Collaborate with Creative teams by providing data-backed recommendations for new concepts, messaging angles, hooks, offers, and creative testing opportunities.

- Contribute ideas during creative strategy discussions while helping ensure creative testing aligns with account priorities.

- Communicate proactively with internal teams regarding campaign performance, blockers, and opportunities.

- Participate in client calls as needed and communicate confidently in written client updates.



---



What Success Looks Like



Successful Media Buyers consistently:



- Execute campaigns accurately, efficiently, and with exceptional attention to detail.

- Achieve client MER, aMER, CAC and bCAC goals through disciplined optimization and testing.

- Move quickly while maintaining a high standard of quality.

- Communicate proactively and collaborate effectively across teams.

- Complete work reliably, follow established processes, and demonstrate strong operational excellence.

- Use data to identify opportunities, solve problems, and improve performance over time.



---



What You Bring to the Table



Required



- 3+ years of experience managing Meta advertising for DTC ecommerce brands.

- Agency experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.

- Experience managing six-figure monthly Meta advertising budgets.

- Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager, campaign structure, audience strategy, and optimization best practices.

- Experience working with Shopify and/or WooCommerce ecommerce brands.

- Ability to analyze creative performance and identify the drivers behind winning and losing campaigns.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and make informed optimization decisions.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Strong written communication skills and comfort participating in client meetings when needed.

- Experience working successfully in a remote environment.

- Ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.



Preferred

- Experience advertising within policy-constrained wellness industries, including hemp, cannabis, telehealth (GLP-1s, peptides), supplements, and functional wellness.

- Experience managing campaigns on TikTok, X, or Snapchat.

- Familiarity with GA4 and ecommerce analytics.

- Experience collaborating closely with creative teams on performance marketing initiatives.



---



Who Thrives at Lucyd



Successful Paid Social Media Buyers at Lucyd are proactive, detail-oriented operators who enjoy turning strategy into execution.



They are analytical, adaptable, and naturally curious about what drives performance. They communicate clearly, take ownership of their work, and move quickly without sacrificing quality. description:
Design only. No coding — a separate developer builds what you design.



I'm launching an agency that helps businesses use AI in the workplace. I need the website designed properly before anyone builds it.



This is a one-off project, but I'm using it to test the waters for an ongoing AI-focused design position. If it goes well, there's more.



What needs designing - Desktop and mobile:



Home — hero built around a main video I'll supply, then sections for my products (templates), my services (building tools and websites), what's new, and get in touch.

Shop — the template products.

A single template product page — what someone sees when they click one.

Resources — YouTube videos, blog posts and podcasts.

A single blog post / video / podcast page — what someone sees when they click one.

Contact.

The reusable bits — menu, footer, buttons, cards, forms. Designed once, used across every page.

The colour scheme and fonts applied consistently across all of it, including how it looks in dark mode.



I have a mood board and a rough colour direction to hand over. Applying it properly across the whole site will be your responsibility .



I am very interested in also knowing the process of using AI and what tools you've used exactly and where. This is the exact position I am trying to fill and I am testing the waters to see what talent is currently out there. A handover of some sort showing output of the AI that you've used and the tool within that is required within this project. 



Who I'm looking for

You already design with AI. It runs through your ideation — concepts, direction, exploration — and you know where the human takes over and why. This is not a "willing to learn" role. If that's not how you work today, this one isn't for you.



Years designing websites specifically — not logos and social tiles that occasionally became a web page.



You can explain why a palette works: contrast, restraint, where accent colour earns its place, how it holds up in light and dark.

Typography is a deliberate choice, not a default font.





To apply, send:

1. Tell me what you need from me before you can start.

What discovery documents or business information would you need in order to design this properly? List them. If you have a client discovery or intake questionnaire you normally send mention this.



2. Brand guideline documents you've created yourself. 



3. Websites you've designed. Links or screens. Tell me which parts were yours.



4. The AI tools you use and where they sit in your process.



5. Your rate for the project and rough turnaround.



Deliverable is clean, developer-ready files (Figma preferred) my build team can work straight from.



On AI costs

I don't think your tools should come out of your pocket. Tell me what you use and we'll sort out reimbursement, or I'll find a way to fund the subscription.



No brand guidelines and no website work means no reply.

title: Senior Growth Product Lead (Hunting + P&L)| Work directly with the founder
description:
I run an international e-commerce group. We source in China, we manufacture our own cosmetics, and we sell DTC brands in Europe, the US and the Gulf. I'm opening a product cell and I'm hiring its first senior member. You would be employee #1 of this cell. The hunters we recruit after you will report to you.



Here's the honest version of the job.



Every day, products are blowing up somewhere: an ad that's been scaling for 12 days on Meta US, a TikTok Shop product doing crazy GMV that nobody runs in Europe yet. Your job is to catch these signals early, then do what almost nobody in this market does: open the spreadsheet. Landed cost, margin (we don't launch under 4x), realistic CAC against the AOV, demand checked outside the ad platform. Then you bring me ONE product a day maximum with a clear GO, and you kill the rest in writing. I make the final call, but your judgment is what I'm paying for.



What I need you to already have:



3 to 5+ years in DTC or dropshipping where you did BOTH sides. Maybe you ran your own store with your own money. Maybe you were the media buyer who also picked the products. What matters is that you've chosen products AND lived with their numbers afterwards.



You use spy tools daily. WinningHunter, PiPiAds, Kalodata, Minea, whatever your stack is, you'll show it to me live on screen share during the interview. Yes, live. If that sentence makes you uncomfortable, don't apply.



You have a graveyard. Products you refused to launch, campaigns you killed while the metrics still looked pretty. If you can't name one, you've never really d
 anything.



Excel or Sheets at the level where you BUILD the unit economics model, not fill in someone else's.



What you get: weekly pay, a real seat (your calls go straight to me, no layers), and a team that will grow under you if you're as good as your application says. We start with a paid test mission of 2 to 3 days. Real products, real money, real decision at the end. We're a business in launch mode: if you're good, you'll know within a week, not after 4 rounds of interviews.



**HOW TO APPLY. Read this part twice.**



Generic applications get deleted without being read. Start your message with the word OPERATOR, then answer these 3 questions and nothing else:



1. One product you spotted early and pushed to launch: what was the first signal, and what were the numbers that made it a GO?

2. One product with beautiful ad metrics that you still killed: what did the spreadsheet say that the ads didn't?

3. Your spy tool stack + 2 or 3 time slots this week for an online interview (PH time).



Sharp answers get an interview within 24 hours. I'm hiring now, not next month.

mber who will stay and grow at our company. We offer competitive compensation and a good work environment.





WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Maintain brand consistency across every output, staying within each brand's color palette, lighting style, prop language, and overall aesthetic (HiEnd Accents vs. Paseo Road vs. our other brands)



- Iterate quickly on feedback from the marketing and creative teams, delivering multiple variations and revisions per brief



- Organize and tag final assets in our shared library (Google Drive, Airtable, Notion) so the rest of the team can find and reuse them



- Track what's working, which creatives are performing on ads, which prompts are producing the best output, and feed those learnings into the next round



- Stay current on new AI image and video tools, model updates, and prompting techniques, and bring promising ones to the team





WHO YOU ARE



- Significant prior experience generating photorealistic product or lifestyle imagery with AI tools (Gemini / Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, or similar) required

- A sharp eye for photorealism: you can spot the tells of AI-generated work (warped elements, melted textures, unnatural shadows, off proportions on furniture and textiles, etc.) and fix them before anyone else sees the file



- Obsessive attention to product accuracy: when comparing your AI output to the actual product photo, you catch the small stuff (a print motif that's slightly off, a flange width that's wrong by a quarter inch, a color that's a shade too warm) and fix it before delivery. The bar is exact match to the real product, not "looks close enough"



- Excellent English skills with high attention to detail and meticulous proofreading of any text or copy in your creatives



- A genuine sense of style and taste in interior design, home decor, and product photography; you understand why a room looks expensive vs. AI-generated stock

, Slack, and Zoom. Highly preferred, but not required: experience with Airtable, Notion, Slack, and Google Drive
